name: quadrature
source:
! Integrate x**2 over [0,1]; verify the result rather than only printing it.
! Module callbacks avoid executable-stack trampolines for internal procedures.
module audit_functions
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use quadrature_module, only: integration_class_1d
   implicit none
contains
   function square(me, x) result(y)
      class(integration_class_1d), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x
   end function square
end module audit_functions

program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use quadrature_module, only: integration_class_1d
   use audit_functions, only: square
   implicit none
   type(integration_class_1d) :: integral
   real(wp) :: answer, estimate
   integer :: status
   call integral%initialize(fx=square, xl=0.0_wp, xu=1.0_wp, tolx=1.0e-10_wp, methodx=8)
   call integral%integrate(answer, status, estimate)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(answer)) error stop 'nonfinite integral'
   if (abs(answer - 1.0_wp/3.0_wp) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'incorrect integral'
   print '(a,f15.12,a,i0)', 'PASS quadrature integral=', answer, ' status=', status
end program demo

name: roots
source:
! Solve x**2 - 2 = 0 with Brent's method.
! Module callbacks avoid executable-stack trampolines for internal procedures.
module audit_functions
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: root_solver
   implicit none
contains
   function equation(me, x) result(y)
      class(root_solver), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x - 2.0_wp
   end function equation
end module audit_functions

program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: brent_solver
   use audit_functions, only: equation
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x, residual
   integer :: status
   type(brent_solver) :: solver
   call solver%initialize(equation, rtol=1.0e-12_wp)
   call solver%solve(0.0_wp, 2.0_wp, x, residual, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(x)) error stop 'nonfinite root'
   if (status /= 0 .or. abs(x - sqrt(2.0_wp)) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'incorrect root'
   print '(a,f15.12)', 'PASS roots sqrt(2)=', x
end program demo

name: pchip
source:
! Interpolate linear data and verify an interior value.
program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use pchip_module, only: dpchim, dpchfe
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(3), f(1,3), d(1,3), query(1), answer(1)
   integer :: status
   logical :: skip
   x = [0.0_wp, 1.0_wp, 2.0_wp]
   f(1,:) = 2*x + 1
   call dpchim(3, x, f, d, 1, status)
   if (status < 0) error stop 'derivative calculation failed'
   skip = .false.
   query = 0.5_wp
   call dpchfe(3, x, f, d, 1, skip, 1, query, answer, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(answer(1))) error stop 'nonfinite interpolation'
   if (status < 0 .or. abs(answer(1) - 2.0_wp) > 1.0e-12_wp) error stop 'incorrect interpolation'
   print '(a,f8.4)', 'PASS pchip value=', answer(1)
end program demo

name: toml
source:
! Parse a small TOML document and retrieve its integer value.
program demo
   use tomlf, only: toml_table, toml_error, toml_parse, get_value
   implicit none
   type(toml_table), allocatable :: table
   type(toml_error), allocatable :: error
   integer :: answer, status
   call toml_parse(table, 'answer = 42', error=error)
   if (allocated(error)) error stop 'TOML parsing failed'
   call get_value(table, 'answer', answer, stat=status)
   if (status /= 0 .or. answer /= 42) error stop 'incorrect TOML value'
   print '(a,i0)', 'PASS toml answer=', answer
end program demo

name: datetime
source:
! Advance across a leap-year day and check the resulting calendar date.
program demo
   use datetime_module
   implicit none
   type(datetime) :: start, finish
   start = datetime(2024, 2, 28)
   finish = start + timedelta(days=2)
   if (finish%getYear() /= 2024 .or. finish%getMonth() /= 3 .or. finish%getDay() /= 1) &
      error stop 'incorrect calendar arithmetic'
   print '(a,a)', 'PASS datetime date=', finish%isoformat()
end program demo

module sine_objective
   use fmin_module, only: wp => fmin_rk
   implicit none
   integer :: calls = 0
contains
   function objective(x) result(f)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: f
      calls = calls + 1
      f = sin(x)
   end function
end module

program gams_fmin_sine
   use fmin_module, only: fmin
   use sine_objective
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x, expected, value
   expected = -acos(-1.0_wp)/2
   x = fmin(objective, -4.0_wp, 0.0_wp, 1.0e-8_wp)
   value = sin(x)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(x)) error stop 'Nonfinite minimizer'
   if (abs(x-expected)>1.0e-6_wp .or. abs(value+1)>1.0e-12_wp) error stop 'Incorrect minimum'
   print '(a)', 'GAMS G1a: minimize sin(x) on the search interval [-4,0].'
   print '(a,f16.10)', 'Computed x: ', x
   print '(a,es12.3)', 'Absolute solution error: ', abs(x-expected)
   print '(a,f16.10)', 'Independently evaluated objective: ', value
   print '(a,i0)', 'Objective calls: ', calls
   print '(a)', 'PASS fmin-sine'
end program

! Adapted from jacobwilliams/minpack examples/example_lmdif1.f90 at
! c0b5aea9fcd2b83865af921a7a7e881904f8d3c2.
! Changes: module callback, shared Bard-15 model, independent reference checks.
module bard_problem
   use minpack_module, only: wp
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: observations(15) = [ &
      .14_wp,.18_wp,.22_wp,.25_wp,.29_wp,.32_wp,.35_wp,.39_wp, &
      .37_wp,.58_wp,.73_wp,.96_wp,1.34_wp,2.10_wp,4.39_wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: expected(3) = [.08241058_wp,1.133037_wp,2.343695_wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: expected_norm = .09063596_wp
   integer :: calls = 0
contains
   subroutine evaluate(x,residual)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(3)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: residual(15)
      integer :: i
      do i=1,15
         residual(i) = observations(i) - (x(1)+real(i,wp)/ &
            (x(2)*real(16-i,wp)+x(3)*real(min(i,16-i),wp)))
      end do
   end subroutine

   subroutine callback(m,n,x,residual,iflag)
      integer, intent(in) :: m,n
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(n)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: residual(m)
      integer, intent(inout) :: iflag
      if (iflag>0) then
         calls = calls + 1
         call evaluate(x,residual)
      end if
   end subroutine
end module

program gams_minpack_bard
   use minpack_module, only: lmdif1
   use bard_problem
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=3,m=15,lwa=m*n+5*n+m
   real(wp) :: x(n),residual(m),work(lwa),residual_norm,parameter_error
   integer :: info,ipvt(n)
   x = [1.0_wp,1.0_wp,1.0_wp]
   call lmdif1(callback,m,n,x,residual,1.0e-10_wp,info,ipvt,work,lwa)
   call evaluate(x,residual)
   residual_norm = norm2(residual)
   parameter_error = maxval(abs(x-expected))
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(x)) .or. .not. ieee_is_finite(residual_norm)) error stop 'Nonfinite fit'
   if (info<1 .or. info>4) error stop 'MINPACK did not converge'
   if (parameter_error>2.0e-4_wp) error stop 'Reference parameters differ'
   if (abs(residual_norm-expected_norm)>1.0e-7_wp) error stop 'Reference residual norm differs'
   print '(a)', 'GAMS G1b: Bard-15 nonlinear least squares, MINPACK lmdif1.'
   print '(a,3f14.8)', 'Parameters: ',x
   print '(a,es12.3)', 'Maximum parameter error: ',parameter_error
   print '(a,es16.8)', 'Independent residual norm: ',residual_norm
   print '(a,i0)', 'Residual callback calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Solver termination code: ',info
   print '(a)', 'PASS minpack-bard'
end program

name: gams-libdogleg-bard
source:
! Adapted from ivan-pi/libdogleg-f example/lmder_example.f90 at
! 32b65ae4f880a052768c05d24c24b79920710681.
! SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
! This adapted example is distributed under LGPL version 3 or later,
! without any warranty. See licenses/libdogleg-COPYING.LESSER and
! licenses/libdogleg-COPYING, or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/.
! Changes: common Bard-15 reference checks and suppressed debug logging.
module bard_problem
   use iso_c_binding, only: wp => c_double
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: observations(15) = [ &
      .14_wp,.18_wp,.22_wp,.25_wp,.29_wp,.32_wp,.35_wp,.39_wp, &
      .37_wp,.58_wp,.73_wp,.96_wp,1.34_wp,2.10_wp,4.39_wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: expected(3) = [.08241058_wp,1.133037_wp,2.343695_wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: expected_norm = .09063596_wp
   integer :: calls = 0
contains
   subroutine evaluate(x,residual)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(3)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: residual(15)
      integer :: i
      do i=1,15
         residual(i) = observations(i) - (x(1)+real(i,wp)/ &
            (x(2)*real(16-i,wp)+x(3)*real(min(i,16-i),wp)))
      end do
   end subroutine

   subroutine callback(x,residual,jacobian,params)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: residual(:),jacobian(:,:)
      class(*), optional, intent(in) :: params
      real(wp) :: denominator,u,v,w
      integer :: i
      calls = calls + 1
      call evaluate(x,residual)
      do i=1,15
         u=real(i,wp); v=real(16-i,wp); w=real(min(i,16-i),wp)
         denominator=(x(2)*v+x(3)*w)**2
         jacobian(1,i)=-1.0_wp
         jacobian(2,i)=u*v/denominator
         jacobian(3,i)=u*w/denominator
      end do
   end subroutine
end module

program gams_libdogleg_bard
   use dogleg, only: dl_parameters2_t,dl_getDefaultParameters,dl_optimize
   use bard_problem
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(dl_parameters2_t) :: settings
   real(wp) :: x(3),objective,residual(15),residual_norm,parameter_error
   x = [1.0_wp,1.0_wp,1.0_wp]
   call dl_getDefaultParameters(settings)
   settings%max_iterations=200
   settings%dogleg_debug=0
   settings%Jt_x_threshold=sqrt(epsilon(1.0_wp))
   settings%update_threshold=sqrt(epsilon(1.0_wp))
   settings%trustregion_threshold=sqrt(epsilon(1.0_wp))
   call dl_optimize(objective,x,15,callback,parameters=settings)
   call evaluate(x,residual)
   residual_norm = norm2(residual)
   parameter_error = maxval(abs(x-expected))
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(x)) .or. .not. ieee_is_finite(residual_norm)) error stop 'Nonfinite fit'
   if (parameter_error>2.0e-4_wp) error stop 'Reference parameters differ'
   if (abs(residual_norm-expected_norm)>1.0e-7_wp) error stop 'Reference residual norm differs'
   print '(a)', 'GAMS G1b: Bard-15 nonlinear least squares, libdogleg-f.'
   print '(a,3f14.8)', 'Parameters: ',x
   print '(a,es12.3)', 'Maximum parameter error: ',parameter_error
   print '(a,es16.8)', 'Independent residual norm: ',residual_norm
   print '(a,i0)', 'Residual and analytic Jacobian callback calls: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'PASS libdogleg-bard'
end program

module rosenbrock_model
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   integer :: objective_calls=0, gradient_calls=0
contains
   function objective(x, args) result(f)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: x(:)
      class(*), optional, intent(inout) :: args
      real(real64) :: f
      objective_calls=objective_calls+1
      f=(1._real64-x(1))**2+100._real64*(x(2)-x(1)**2)**2
   end function
end module
program compare_rosenbrock
   use rosenbrock_model
   use nonlin, only: nelder_mead, fcnnvar_helper, fcnnvar, iteration_behavior
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(nelder_mead) :: solver
   type(fcnnvar_helper) :: obj
   procedure(fcnnvar), pointer :: fcn
   type(iteration_behavior) :: ib
   real(real64) :: x(2), reported, independent, error
   fcn=>objective
   call obj%set_fcn(fcn,2)
   call solver%set_max_fcn_evals(5000)
   call solver%set_tolerance(1.e-12_real64)
   x=[-1.2_real64,1._real64]
   call solver%solve(obj,x,reported,ib)
   if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.ieee_is_finite(reported)) error stop 'nonfinite result'
   independent=(1._real64-x(1))**2+100._real64*(x(2)-x(1)**2)**2
   error=maxval(abs(x-1._real64))
   if (error>1.e-4_real64.or.independent>1.e-10_real64) error stop 'Rosenbrock accuracy'
   if (abs(reported-independent)>1.e-10_real64) error stop 'reported objective mismatch'
   print '(a)', 'GAMS G1b1a: Rosenbrock, nonlin nelder_mead; start (-1.2,1).'
   print '(a,2f16.10)', 'Computed minimizer: ', x
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum parameter error: ', error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Independent objective: ', independent
   print '(a,i0)', 'Objective callback calls: ', objective_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Gradient callback calls: ', gradient_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Solver iterations: ', ib%iter_count
   print '(a)', 'PASS nonlin-rosenbrock-nm'
end program

! AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
! LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
! OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
! SOFTWARE.

module rosenbrock_model
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   integer :: objective_calls=0, gradient_calls=0
contains
   function objective(x, args) result(f)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: x(:)
      class(*), optional, intent(inout) :: args
      real(real64) :: f
      objective_calls=objective_calls+1
      f=(1._real64-x(1))**2+100._real64*(x(2)-x(1)**2)**2
   end function
   subroutine gradient(x, g, args)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(real64), intent(out) :: g(:)
      class(*), optional, intent(inout) :: args
      gradient_calls=gradient_calls+1
      g(1)=2*(x(1)-1)-400*x(1)*(x(2)-x(1)**2)
      g(2)=200*(x(2)-x(1)**2)
   end subroutine
   subroutine check_gradient()
      real(real64) :: x(2), plus(2), minus(2), g(2), fd(2)
      real(real64), parameter :: h=1.e-6_real64
      integer :: i
      x=[-1.2_real64,1._real64]
      call gradient(x,g)
      do i=1,2
         plus=x; minus=x
         plus(i)=plus(i)+h; minus(i)=minus(i)-h
         fd(i)=(objective(plus)-objective(minus))/(2*h)
      end do
      if (maxval(abs(g-fd))>1.e-5_real64) error stop 'analytic gradient check'
      objective_calls=0; gradient_calls=0
   end subroutine
end module
program compare_rosenbrock
   use rosenbrock_model
   use nonlin, only: bfgs, fcnnvar_helper, fcnnvar, iteration_behavior, gradientfcn
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(bfgs) :: solver
   type(fcnnvar_helper) :: obj
   procedure(fcnnvar), pointer :: fcn
   procedure(gradientfcn), pointer :: grad
   type(iteration_behavior) :: ib
   real(real64) :: x(2), reported, independent, error
   fcn=>objective
   call obj%set_fcn(fcn,2)
   call check_gradient()
   grad=>gradient
   call obj%set_gradient_fcn(grad)
   call solver%set_max_fcn_evals(5000)
   call solver%set_tolerance(1.e-12_real64)
   x=[-1.2_real64,1._real64]
   call solver%solve(obj,x,reported,ib)
   if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.ieee_is_finite(reported)) error stop 'nonfinite result'
   independent=(1._real64-x(1))**2+100._real64*(x(2)-x(1)**2)**2
   error=maxval(abs(x-1._real64))
   if (error>1.e-4_real64.or.independent>1.e-10_real64) error stop 'Rosenbrock accuracy'
   if (abs(reported-independent)>1.e-10_real64) error stop 'reported objective mismatch'
   print '(a)', 'GAMS G1b1b: Rosenbrock, nonlin bfgs; start (-1.2,1).'
   print '(a,2f16.10)', 'Computed minimizer: ', x
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum parameter error: ', error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Independent objective: ', independent
   print '(a,i0)', 'Objective callback calls: ', objective_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Gradient callback calls: ', gradient_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Solver iterations: ', ib%iter_count

! SOFTWARE.

module rosenbrock_model
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   integer :: objective_calls=0, gradient_calls=0
contains
   function objective(x, gradient, func_data) result(f)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(real64), optional, intent(inout) :: gradient(:)
      class(*), optional, intent(in) :: func_data
      real(real64) :: f
      objective_calls=objective_calls+1
      f=(1._real64-x(1))**2+100._real64*(x(2)-x(1)**2)**2
      if (present(gradient)) then
         gradient_calls=gradient_calls+1
         gradient(1)=2*(x(1)-1)-400*x(1)*(x(2)-x(1)**2)
         gradient(2)=200*(x(2)-x(1)**2)
      end if
   end function
   subroutine check_gradient()
      real(real64) :: x(2), plus(2), minus(2), g(2), fd(2), unused
      real(real64), parameter :: h=1.e-6_real64
      integer :: i
      x=[-1.2_real64,1._real64]
      unused=objective(x,g)
      do i=1,2
         plus=x; minus=x
         plus(i)=plus(i)+h; minus(i)=minus(i)-h
         fd(i)=(objective(plus)-objective(minus))/(2*h)
      end do
      if (maxval(abs(g-fd))>1.e-5_real64) error stop 'analytic gradient check'
      objective_calls=0; gradient_calls=0
   end subroutine
end module
program compare_rosenbrock
   use rosenbrock_model
   use nlopt_wrap
   use nlopt_enum, only: algorithm_from_string
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(nlopt_opt) :: opt
   real(real64) :: x(2), reported, independent, error
   integer :: status
   call check_gradient()
   call create(opt,algorithm_from_string('LD_LBFGS'),2)
   associate(f=>nlopt_func(objective))
      call opt%set_min_objective(f,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'set objective'
      call opt%set_xtol_rel(1.e-9_real64,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'set variable tolerance'
      call opt%set_ftol_abs(1.e-14_real64,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'set function tolerance'
      call opt%set_maxeval(5000,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'set evaluation limit'
      x=[-1.2_real64,1._real64]
      call opt%optimize(x,reported,status)
   end associate
   call destroy(opt)
   if (status<0.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.ieee_is_finite(reported)) &
      error stop 'optimization failed'
   independent=(1._real64-x(1))**2+100._real64*(x(2)-x(1)**2)**2
   error=maxval(abs(x-1._real64))
   if (error>1.e-4_real64.or.independent>1.e-10_real64) error stop 'Rosenbrock accuracy'
   if (abs(reported-independent)>1.e-10_real64) error stop 'reported objective mismatch'
   print '(a)', 'GAMS G1b1b: Rosenbrock, NLopt LD_LBFGS; start (-1.2,1).'
   print '(a,2f16.10)', 'Computed minimizer: ', x
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum parameter error: ', error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Independent objective: ', independent
   print '(a,i0)', 'Objective callback calls: ', objective_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Gradient callback calls: ', gradient_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Solver termination code: ', status
   print '(a)', 'PASS nlopt-rosenbrock-lbfgs'
end program

name: gams-roots-fortran-brent
source:
! Original checked example using the public roots-fortran object API.
module root_equations
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use root_module, only: root_solver
   implicit none
   integer :: problem=1, calls=0, derivative_calls=0
contains
   function value(x) result(y)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      if (problem==1) then
         y=sin(x)/x
      else
         y=exp(x)-2._wp
      end if
   end function
   function equation(me,x) result(y)
      class(root_solver), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      calls=calls+1
      y=value(x)
   end function
end module
program checked_scalar_roots
   use root_equations
   use root_module, only: brent_solver
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(brent_solver) :: solver
   integer :: status
   real(wp) :: a,b,x,residual,expected,actual_error
   call solver%initialize(equation,ftol=1.e-12_wp,rtol=1.e-12_wp,atol=1.e-12_wp,maxiter=200)
   do problem=1,2
      if (problem==1) then
         a=1.5_wp; b=5._wp
      else
         a=0._wp; b=2._wp
      end if
      calls=0; derivative_calls=0
      call solver%solve(a,b,x,residual,status)
      if (status/=0) error stop 'roots-fortran status'
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(x).or..not.ieee_is_finite(residual)) error stop 'nonfinite root/residual'
      if (x<a.or.x>b) error stop 'root outside bracket'
      if (problem==1) then
         expected=acos(-1._wp)
         print '(a)', 'Case: sin(x)/x = 0 on [1.5,5], root pi'
      else
         expected=log(2._wp)
         print '(a)', 'Case: exp(x)-2 = 0 on [0,2], root log(2)'
      end if
      actual_error=abs(x-expected)
      if (actual_error>1.e-9_wp.or.abs(value(x))>1.e-9_wp) error stop 'independent root accuracy'
      if (abs(residual-value(x))>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'reported residual disagreement'
      if (calls<=0) error stop 'missing function evaluations'
      print '(a,es22.14)', 'Computed root: ', x
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Actual root error: ', actual_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Independent absolute residual: ', abs(value(x))
      print '(a,i0)', 'Function callback calls: ', calls
      print '(a,i0)', 'Derivative callback calls: ', derivative_calls
      print '(a,i0)', 'Solver status: ', status
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS roots-fortran-brent'
end program

module root_equations

contains
   function value(x) result(y)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      if (problem==1) then
         y=sin(x)/x
      else
         y=exp(x)-2._wp

   end function

      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      class(*), optional, intent(inout) :: args
      real(wp) :: y

      y=value(x)
   end function
   function derivative(x,args) result(y)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      class(*), optional, intent(inout) :: args
      real(wp) :: y
      derivative_calls=derivative_calls+1
      if (problem==1) then
         y=cos(x)/x-sin(x)/(x*x)

program checked_scalar_roots
   use root_equations
   use nonlin
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite

   real(wp) :: midpoint,h,estimate
   fcn=>equation
   call objective%set_fcn(fcn)
   call solver%set_fcn_tolerance(1.e-12_wp)
   call solver%set_var_tolerance(1.e-12_wp)
   call solver%set_max_fcn_evals(200)
   diff=>derivative
   call objective%set_diff(diff)
   do problem=1,2
      if (problem==1) then
         a=1.5_wp; b=5._wp
      else
         a=0._wp; b=2._wp
      end if
      calls=0; derivative_calls=0
      ! Sanity check the supplied derivative, outside the solver counters.
      midpoint=(a+b)/2._wp
      h=epsilon(1._wp)**(1._wp/3._wp)*max(1._wp,abs(midpoint))
      estimate=(value(midpoint+h)-value(midpoint-h))/(2._wp*h)
      if (abs(derivative(midpoint)-estimate)>1.e-7_wp) error stop 'analytic derivative check'
      derivative_calls=0
      limits%x1=a; limits%x2=b
      x=(a+b)/2._wp
      call solver%solve(objective,x,limits,residual,ib=tracking)
      if (.not.(tracking%converge_on_fcn.or.tracking%converge_on_chng)) error stop 'solver convergence'
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(x).or..not.ieee_is_finite(residual)) error stop 'nonfinite root/residual'
      if (x<a.or.x>b) error stop 'root outside bracket'
      if (problem==1) then
         expected=acos(-1._wp)
         print '(a)', 'Case: sin(x)/x = 0 on [1.5,5], root pi'
      else
         expected=log(2._wp)
         print '(a)', 'Case: exp(x)-2 = 0 on [0,2], root log(2)'
      end if
      actual_error=abs(x-expected)
      if (actual_error>1.e-9_wp.or.abs(value(x))>1.e-9_wp) error stop 'independent root accuracy'
      if (abs(residual-value(x))>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'reported residual disagreement'
      if (calls<=0) error stop 'missing function evaluations'
      print '(a,es22.14)', 'Computed root: ', x
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Actual root error: ', actual_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Independent absolute residual: ', abs(value(x))
      print '(a,i0)', 'Function callback calls: ', calls
      print '(a,i0)', 'Derivative callback calls: ', derivative_calls
      if (derivative_calls<=0) error stop 'analytic derivative was not used'
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS nonlin-roots-newton'
end program

program checked_linear_algebra

   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use linear_algebra, only: lstsq
   use la_state_type, only: la_state
   use la_constants, only: ilp
   implicit none
   type(la_state) :: state
   real(wp), parameter :: t(5)=[-2._wp,-1._wp,0._wp,1._wp,2._wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: noise(5)=[1._wp,-2._wp,2._wp,-2._wp,1._wp]
   real(wp), allocatable :: a(:,:),original(:,:),x(:),expected(:)
   real(wp) :: b(5),rhs(5),residual(5),coefficient_error,optimality,sse
   integer(ilp) :: rank
   integer :: problem,n
   do problem=1,2
      ! Noise is orthogonal to both columns, giving known least-squares coefficients.
      n=problem+1
      allocate(a(5,n),expected(n))
      a(:,1)=1._wp; a(:,2)=t
      if (problem==1) then
         expected=[1._wp,2._wp]
      else
         ! Duplicate columns: infinitely many solutions; [1,1,1] has minimum norm.
         a(:,3)=t
         expected=[1._wp,1._wp,1._wp]
      end if
      b=1._wp+2._wp*t+noise
      original=a; rhs=b
      x=lstsq(a,b,rank=rank,err=state)
      if (state%error()) then
         print *, state%print()
         error stop 'least-squares solver status'
      end if
      if (size(x)/=n.or.rank/=2) error stop 'solution shape or numerical rank'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite coefficients'
      residual=matmul(original,x)-rhs
      coefficient_error=maxval(abs(x-expected))
      optimality=maxval(abs(matmul(transpose(original),residual)))
      sse=sum(residual**2)
      if (coefficient_error>1.e-10_wp.or.optimality>1.e-10_wp) error stop 'least-squares optimality'
      if (abs(sse-14._wp)>1.e-10_wp) error stop 'least-squares residual sum of squares'
      print '(a,i0)', 'Least-squares case (2 has duplicate columns): ', problem
      print '(a,*(f18.12))', 'Coefficients: ', x
      print '(a,i0)', 'Numerical rank: ', rank
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum coefficient error: ', coefficient_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum absolute A-transpose residual: ', optimality
      print '(a,f18.12)', 'Residual sum of squares (expected 14): ', sse
      deallocate(a,expected)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortran-lapack-least-squares'
end program

module ode_problem
   use dop853_module, only: dop853_class, wp=>dop853_wp
   implicit none
   integer :: rhs_calls=0
contains
   subroutine equations(me,t,y,dy)
      class(dop853_class), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: t,y(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: dy(:)
      rhs_calls=rhs_calls+1
      dy=[-y(1),y(3),-y(2)]
   end subroutine
   function exact(t) result(y)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: t
      real(wp) :: y(3)
      y=[exp(-t),cos(t),-sin(t)]
   end function
end module
program checked_nonstiff_ivp
   use ode_problem
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(dop853_class) :: solver
   real(wp) :: t,target,y(3),period,solution_error,energy_error,max_error,max_energy_error
   integer :: checkpoint,status
   logical :: initialized
   period=2._wp*acos(-1._wp)
   t=0._wp; y=exact(t); rhs_calls=0
   max_error=0._wp; max_energy_error=0._wp
   call solver%initialize(n=3,fcn=equations,status_ok=initialized)
   if (.not.initialized) error stop 'DOP853 initialization'
   print '(a)', '       t      max state error      oscillator energy error'
   do checkpoint=1,10
      target=period*real(checkpoint,wp)/10._wp
      call solver%integrate(t,y,target,[1.e-10_wp],[1.e-10_wp],0,status)
      if (status/=1) error stop 'DOP853 did not complete integration'
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(t).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'nonfinite ODE result'
      if (abs(t-target)>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'incorrect output time'
      solution_error=maxval(abs(y-exact(target)))
      energy_error=abs(y(2)**2+y(3)**2-1._wp)
      if (solution_error>1.e-8_wp.or.energy_error>2.e-8_wp) error stop 'independent ODE accuracy'
      if (y(1)<0._wp) error stop 'negative decay state'
      max_error=max(max_error,solution_error)
      max_energy_error=max(max_energy_error,energy_error)
      print '(f10.6,2es22.10)', t,solution_error,energy_error
   end do
   if (rhs_calls<=0) error stop 'no RHS evaluations'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum checkpoint state error: ', max_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum checkpoint energy error: ', max_energy_error
   print '(a,i0)', 'RHS callback calls (checkpoint run): ', rhs_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Final solver status: ', status
   print '(a)', 'PASS dop853-decay-oscillator'
end program

module ode_problem
   use ddeabm_module, only: ddeabm_class, wp=>ddeabm_rk
   implicit none
   integer :: rhs_calls=0
contains
   subroutine equations(me,t,y,dy)
      class(ddeabm_class), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: t,y(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: dy(:)
      rhs_calls=rhs_calls+1
      dy=[-y(1),y(3),-y(2)]
   end subroutine
   function exact(t) result(y)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: t
      real(wp) :: y(3)
      y=[exp(-t),cos(t),-sin(t)]
   end function
end module
program checked_nonstiff_ivp
   use ode_problem
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(ddeabm_class) :: solver
   real(wp) :: t,target,y(3),period,solution_error,energy_error,max_error,max_energy_error
   integer :: checkpoint,status
   period=2._wp*acos(-1._wp)
   t=0._wp; y=exact(t); rhs_calls=0
   max_error=0._wp; max_energy_error=0._wp
   call solver%initialize(neq=3,maxnum=10000,df=equations,rtol=[1.e-10_wp],atol=[1.e-10_wp])
   print '(a)', '       t      max state error      oscillator energy error'
   do checkpoint=1,10
      target=period*real(checkpoint,wp)/10._wp
      call solver%integrate(t,y,target,idid=status)
      if (status/=2.and.status/=3) error stop 'DDEABM did not reach requested time'
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(t).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'nonfinite ODE result'
      if (abs(t-target)>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'incorrect output time'
      solution_error=maxval(abs(y-exact(target)))
      energy_error=abs(y(2)**2+y(3)**2-1._wp)
      if (solution_error>1.e-8_wp.or.energy_error>2.e-8_wp) error stop 'independent ODE accuracy'
      if (y(1)<0._wp) error stop 'negative decay state'
      max_error=max(max_error,solution_error)
      max_energy_error=max(max_energy_error,energy_error)
      print '(f10.6,2es22.10)', t,solution_error,energy_error
   end do
   if (rhs_calls<=0) error stop 'no RHS evaluations'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum checkpoint state error: ', max_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum checkpoint energy error: ', max_energy_error
   print '(a,i0)', 'RHS callback calls (checkpoint run): ', rhs_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Final solver status: ', status
   print '(a)', 'PASS ddeabm-decay-oscillator'
end program

   integer :: rhs_calls=0
contains

program checked_nonstiff_ivp
   use ode_problem
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use rklib_module, only: rk4_class
   implicit none
   type(rk4_class) :: solver
   real(wp) :: t,target,y(3),period,solution_error,energy_error,max_error,max_energy_error
   integer :: checkpoint,status
   real(wp) :: next_y(3),step,refinement_errors(2),ratio
   integer :: refinement,steps
   period=2._wp*acos(-1._wp)
   t=0._wp; y=exact(t); rhs_calls=0
   max_error=0._wp; max_energy_error=0._wp
   call solver%initialize(n=3,f=equations)
   step=0.01_wp
   print '(a)', '       t      max state error      oscillator energy error'
   do checkpoint=1,10
      target=period*real(checkpoint,wp)/10._wp
      call solver%integrate(t,y,step,target,next_y)
      call solver%status(istatus=status)
      if (status/=0) error stop 'RK4 solver status'
      y=next_y
      t=target
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(t).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'nonfinite ODE result'
      if (abs(t-target)>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'incorrect output time'
      solution_error=maxval(abs(y-exact(target)))
      energy_error=abs(y(2)**2+y(3)**2-1._wp)
      if (solution_error>1.e-8_wp.or.energy_error>2.e-8_wp) error stop 'independent ODE accuracy'
      if (y(1)<0._wp) error stop 'negative decay state'
      max_error=max(max_error,solution_error)
      max_energy_error=max(max_energy_error,energy_error)
      print '(f10.6,2es22.10)', t,solution_error,energy_error
   end do
   if (rhs_calls<=0) error stop 'no RHS evaluations'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum checkpoint state error: ', max_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum checkpoint energy error: ', max_energy_error
   print '(a,i0)', 'RHS callback calls (checkpoint run): ', rhs_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Final solver status: ', status
   ! Separate endpoint convergence experiment; not part of the checkpoint counters.
   do refinement=1,2
      steps=100*2**(refinement-1)
      rhs_calls=0
      call solver%initialize(n=3,f=equations)
      call solver%integrate(0._wp,exact(0._wp),period/real(steps,wp),period,y)
      call solver%status(istatus=status)
      if (status/=0.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'RK4 refinement run'
      refinement_errors(refinement)=maxval(abs(y-exact(period)))
      if (refinement_errors(refinement)<=0._wp) error stop 'invalid convergence error'
      print '(a,i0,a,es12.4,a,i0)', 'RK4 nominal steps: ',steps, &
         '; endpoint state error: ',refinement_errors(refinement),'; RHS calls: ',rhs_calls
   end do
   ratio=refinement_errors(1)/refinement_errors(2)
   if (ratio<12._wp.or.ratio>20._wp) error stop 'RK4 fourth-order step refinement'
   print '(a,f12.6)', 'Coarse/fine error ratio (fourth order suggests 16): ', ratio
   print '(a)', 'PASS rklib-decay-oscillator'
end program

source:
! Adapted author interpolation API patterns; shared deterministic data and checks.
! finterp: Modern Fortran Multidimensional Linear Interpolation
! https://github.com/jacobwilliams/finterp

! LOSS OF USE, DATA, OR PROFITS; OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION) HOWEVER CAUSED AND ON
! ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY, OR TORT
! (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE OF THIS
! SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
program checked_interpolation
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use linear_interpolation_module, only: linear_interp_1d
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=6
   real(wp), parameter :: x(n)=[0._wp,0.25_wp,0.5_wp,1._wp,2._wp,3._wp]
   real(wp) :: f(n),query,answer,previous,reference,theta
   real(wp) :: node_error,affine_error,linear_difference,bound_violation,decrease
   integer :: problem,i,j,evaluations
   type(linear_interp_1d) :: interpolator
   integer :: status
   do problem=1,2
      if (problem==1) then
         f=2._wp*x-1._wp
         print '(a)', 'Case: affine data f(x)=2*x-1'
      else
         f=[0._wp,0.01_wp,0.02_wp,0.9_wp,0.95_wp,1._wp]
         print '(a)', 'Case: steep monotone data'
      end if
      call interpolator%initialize(x,f,status)
      if (status/=0) error stop 'interpolator initialization'
      evaluations=0; node_error=0._wp; affine_error=0._wp; linear_difference=0._wp
      bound_violation=0._wp; decrease=0._wp
      do i=1,n
         call evaluate(x(i),answer)
         node_error=max(node_error,abs(answer-f(i)))
      end do
      if (node_error>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'interpolation at original nodes'
      previous=f(1)
      print '(a)', '  Interval midpoint       Interpolated value'
      do i=1,n-1
         do j=0,20
            theta=real(j,wp)/20._wp
            query=x(i)+theta*(x(i+1)-x(i))
            call evaluate(query,answer)
            reference=(1._wp-theta)*f(i)+theta*f(i+1)
            linear_difference=max(linear_difference,abs(answer-reference))
            bound_violation=max(bound_violation,f(i)-answer,answer-f(i+1))
            decrease=max(decrease,previous-answer)
            if (problem==1) affine_error=max(affine_error,abs(answer-(2._wp*query-1._wp)))
            if (j==10) print '(2f24.14)', query,answer
            previous=answer
         end do
      end do
      if (bound_violation>1.e-12_wp.or.decrease>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'sampled monotonicity or overshoot'
      if (affine_error>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'affine preservation'
      if (linear_difference>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'piecewise linear reference'
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum node error: ',node_error
      if (problem==1) print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum affine reproduction error: ',affine_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum difference from piecewise linear: ',linear_difference
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum sampled local bound violation: ',bound_violation
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum sampled decrease: ',decrease
      print '(a,i0)', 'Evaluator calls: ',evaluations
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS finterp-shape-interpolation'
contains
   subroutine evaluate(t,value)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: t
      real(wp), intent(out) :: value
      evaluations=evaluations+1
      call interpolator%evaluate(t,value,status)
      if (status/=0.or..not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'interpolation evaluation'
   end subroutine
end program

      if (status/=0) error stop 'interpolator initialization'
      evaluations=0; node_error=0._wp; affine_error=0._wp; linear_difference=0._wp

         call evaluate(x(i),answer)

      if (node_error>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'interpolation at original nodes'

      print '(a)', '  Interval midpoint       Interpolated value'

            reference=(1._wp-theta)*f(i)+theta*f(i+1)
            linear_difference=max(linear_difference,abs(answer-reference))
            bound_violation=max(bound_violation,f(i)-answer,answer-f(i+1))
            decrease=max(decrease,previous-answer)
            if (problem==1) affine_error=max(affine_error,abs(answer-(2._wp*query-1._wp)))
            if (j==10) print '(2f24.14)', query,answer
            previous=answer
         end do
      end do
      if (bound_violation>1.e-12_wp.or.decrease>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'sampled monotonicity or overshoot'
      if (affine_error>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'affine preservation'
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum node error: ',node_error
      if (problem==1) print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum affine reproduction error: ',affine_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum difference from piecewise linear: ',linear_difference
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum sampled local bound violation: ',bound_violation
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum sampled decrease: ',decrease
      print '(a,i0)', 'Evaluator calls: ',evaluations
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS pchip-shape-interpolation'
contains
   subroutine evaluate(t,value)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: t
      real(wp), intent(out) :: value
      evaluations=evaluations+1
      skip=.false.
      queries(1)=t
      call dpchfe(n,x,tabulated,slopes,1,skip,1,queries,answers,status)
      value=answers(1)
      if (status/=0.or..not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'interpolation evaluation'
   end subroutine
end program

      call interpolator%initialize(x,f,2_ip,status)
      if (status/=0) error stop 'interpolator initialization'
      evaluations=0; node_error=0._wp; affine_error=0._wp; linear_difference=0._wp
      bound_violation=0._wp; decrease=0._wp
      do i=1,n
         call evaluate(x(i),answer)
         node_error=max(node_error,abs(answer-f(i)))
      end do
      if (node_error>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'interpolation at original nodes'
      previous=f(1)
      print '(a)', '  Interval midpoint       Interpolated value'
      do i=1,n-1
         do j=0,20
            theta=real(j,wp)/20._wp
            query=x(i)+theta*(x(i+1)-x(i))
            call evaluate(query,answer)
            reference=(1._wp-theta)*f(i)+theta*f(i+1)
            linear_difference=max(linear_difference,abs(answer-reference))
            bound_violation=max(bound_violation,f(i)-answer,answer-f(i+1))
            decrease=max(decrease,previous-answer)
            if (problem==1) affine_error=max(affine_error,abs(answer-(2._wp*query-1._wp)))
            if (j==10) print '(2f24.14)', query,answer
            previous=answer
         end do
      end do
      if (bound_violation>1.e-12_wp.or.decrease>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'sampled monotonicity or overshoot'
      if (affine_error>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'affine preservation'
      if (linear_difference>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'piecewise linear reference'
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum node error: ',node_error
      if (problem==1) print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum affine reproduction error: ',affine_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum difference from piecewise linear: ',linear_difference
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum sampled local bound violation: ',bound_violation
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum sampled decrease: ',decrease
      print '(a,i0)', 'Evaluator calls: ',evaluations
   end do
   ! Order 4 means cubic pieces. This separate check does not assert shape preservation.
   f=polynomial(x)
   call interpolator%initialize(x,f,4_ip,status)
   if (status/=0) error stop 'cubic B-spline initialization'
   cubic_error=0._wp; derivative_error=0._wp
   do j=0,100
      query=x(1)+(x(n)-x(1))*real(j,wp)/100._wp
      call interpolator%evaluate(query,0_ip,answer,status)
      if (status/=0.or..not.ieee_is_finite(answer)) error stop 'cubic value evaluation'
      cubic_error=max(cubic_error,abs(answer-polynomial(query)))
      call interpolator%evaluate(query,1_ip,answer,status)
      if (status/=0.or..not.ieee_is_finite(answer)) error stop 'cubic derivative evaluation'
      derivative_error=max(derivative_error,abs(answer-(-2._wp+query+3._wp*query**2)))
   end do
   if (cubic_error>1.e-10_wp.or.derivative_error>1.e-10_wp) error stop 'cubic reproduction'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Cubic reproduction maximum error: ',cubic_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Cubic first derivative maximum error: ',derivative_error
   call interpolator%destroy()
   print '(a)', 'PASS bspline-fortran-shape-interpolation'
contains
   subroutine evaluate(t,value)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: t
      real(wp), intent(out) :: value
      evaluations=evaluations+1
      call interpolator%evaluate(t,0_ip,value,status)
      if (status/=0.or..not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'interpolation evaluation'
   end subroutine
   elemental function polynomial(t) result(value)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: t
      real(wp) :: value
      value=1._wp-2._wp*t+0.5_wp*t**2+t**3
   end function
end program

program checked_transform
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use fftpack, only: fft,ifft,wp=>rk
   implicit none
   integer :: test,n,j,k
   real(wp) :: pi,angle,forward_error,roundtrip_error
   complex(wp), allocatable :: signal(:),spectrum(:),reference(:),restored(:)
   real(wp) :: energy_error
   pi=acos(-1._wp)
   do test=1,2
      n=6+test
      allocate(signal(n),reference(n),spectrum(n),restored(n))
      do j=0,n-1
         signal(j+1)=cmplx(real(j+1,wp)/8._wp,real((-1)**j,wp)/4._wp,wp)
      end do
      ! Independent O(N**2) DFT reference, using the negative-exponent convention.
      reference=cmplx(0._wp,0._wp,wp)
      do k=0,n-1
         do j=0,n-1
            angle=-2._wp*pi*real(j*k,wp)/real(n,wp)
            reference(k+1)=reference(k+1)+signal(j+1)*cmplx(cos(angle),sin(angle),wp)
         end do
      end do
      spectrum=fft(signal)
      restored=ifft(spectrum)/real(n,wp)
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real(spectrum))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(spectrum)))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite forward FFT'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real(restored))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(restored)))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite inverse FFT'
      energy_error=abs(sum(abs(spectrum)**2)/real(n,wp)-sum(abs(signal)**2))/max(1._wp,sum(abs(signal)**2))
      if (energy_error>1.e-11_wp) error stop 'Parseval energy identity'
      forward_error=maxval(abs(spectrum-reference))
      roundtrip_error=maxval(abs(restored-signal))
      if (forward_error>1.e-11_wp.or.roundtrip_error>1.e-11_wp) &
         error stop 'direct reference or round-trip accuracy'
      print '(a,i0)', 'Transform length: ',n
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum forward error against direct sum: ',forward_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized inverse error: ',roundtrip_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Relative Parseval energy error: ',energy_error
      deallocate(signal,reference,spectrum,restored)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS fftpack-complex-transform'
end program

program checked_transform
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use iso_c_binding, only: c_associated,c_float
   use kissfft, only: fft,kiss_fft_cpx
   implicit none
   integer :: test,n,j,k
   real(wp) :: pi,angle,forward_error,roundtrip_error
   complex(wp), allocatable :: signal(:),spectrum(:),reference(:),restored(:)
   real(wp) :: energy_error
   pi=acos(-1._wp)
   do test=1,2
      n=6+test
      allocate(signal(n),reference(n),spectrum(n),restored(n))
      do j=0,n-1
         signal(j+1)=cmplx(real(j+1,wp)/8._wp,real((-1)**j,wp)/4._wp,wp)
      end do
      ! Independent O(N**2) DFT reference, using the negative-exponent convention.
      reference=cmplx(0._wp,0._wp,wp)
      do k=0,n-1
         do j=0,n-1
            angle=-2._wp*pi*real(j*k,wp)/real(n,wp)
            reference(k+1)=reference(k+1)+signal(j+1)*cmplx(cos(angle),sin(angle),wp)
         end do
      end do
      block
         ! Each plan is initialized once; block exit finalizes and frees both plans.
         type(fft) :: forward,inverse
         type(kiss_fft_cpx) :: input(n),output(n),back(n)
         input%re=real(signal,c_float); input%im=real(aimag(signal),c_float)
         call forward%init(n,0)
         call inverse%init(n,1)
         if (.not.c_associated(forward%kiss_fft_cfg).or..not.c_associated(inverse%kiss_fft_cfg)) &
            error stop 'KISS FFT plan allocation'
         call forward%perform(input,output)
         spectrum=cmplx(output%re,output%im,wp)
         call inverse%perform(output,back)
         restored=cmplx(back%re,back%im,wp)/real(n,wp)
      end block
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real(spectrum))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(spectrum)))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite forward FFT'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real(restored))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(restored)))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite inverse FFT'
      energy_error=abs(sum(abs(spectrum)**2)/real(n,wp)-sum(abs(signal)**2))/max(1._wp,sum(abs(signal)**2))
      if (energy_error>1.e-6_wp) error stop 'Parseval energy identity'
      forward_error=maxval(abs(spectrum-reference))
      roundtrip_error=maxval(abs(restored-signal))
      if (forward_error>1.e-5_wp.or.roundtrip_error>1.e-6_wp) &
         error stop 'direct reference or round-trip accuracy'
      print '(a,i0)', 'Transform length: ',n
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum forward error against direct sum: ',forward_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized inverse error: ',roundtrip_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Relative Parseval energy error: ',energy_error
      deallocate(signal,reference,spectrum,restored)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS kissfft-f-complex-transform'
end program

   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: lower(2)=[0._wp,0._wp],upper(2)=[1._wp,2._wp],target(2)=[2._wp,-1._wp]
   integer :: objective_calls=0,gradient_calls=0
contains
   pure function value(x) result(f)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp) :: f
      f=sum((x-target)**2)
   end function
   pure function derivative(x) result(g)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp) :: g(size(x))
      g=2._wp*(x-target)
   end function
   subroutine check_gradient()
      real(wp) :: x(2),plus(2),minus(2),fd(2)
      real(wp), parameter :: h=1.e-6_wp
      integer :: j
      x=[0.25_wp,1._wp]
      do j=1,2
         plus=x; minus=x; plus(j)=plus(j)+h; minus(j)=minus(j)-h
         fd(j)=(value(plus)-value(minus))/(2._wp*h)
      end do
      if (maxval(abs(fd-derivative(x)))>1.e-7_wp) error stop 'analytic objective gradient'
   end subroutine
end module
program checked_box_minimum
   use box_model
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use lbfgsb_module, only: setulb
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(2),reported,independent,feasibility,projected
   integer, parameter :: n=2,mem=5
   real(wp) :: g(n),wa(2*mem*n+5*n+11*mem*mem+8*mem),dsave(29)
   integer :: nbd(n),iwa(3*n),isave(44),iteration
   logical :: lsave(4)
   character(60) :: task,csave
   call check_gradient()
   x=[0.25_wp,1._wp]; nbd=2; task='START'
   do iteration=1,1000
      call setulb(n,mem,x,lower,upper,nbd,reported,g,1.e7_wp,1.e-10_wp, &
         wa,iwa,task,-1,csave,lsave,isave,dsave)
      if (task(1:2)=='FG') then
         reported=value(x); g=derivative(x)
         objective_calls=objective_calls+1; gradient_calls=gradient_calls+1
      else if (task(1:5)/='NEW_X') then
         exit
      end if
   end do
   if (task(1:4)/='CONV') error stop 'L-BFGS-B did not converge'
   if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.ieee_is_finite(reported)) error stop 'nonfinite optimum'
   independent=value(x)
   feasibility=max(0._wp,maxval(lower-x),maxval(x-upper))
   projected=maxval(abs(x-min(upper,max(lower,x-derivative(x)))))
   if (feasibility>1.e-10_wp.or.projected>1.e-8_wp) error stop 'box feasibility/stationarity'
   if (maxval(abs(x-[1._wp,0._wp]))>1.e-8_wp.or.abs(independent-2._wp)>1.e-8_wp) &
      error stop 'known box optimum'
   if (abs(reported-independent)>1.e-10_wp) error stop 'reported objective disagreement'
   if (objective_calls<=0.or.gradient_calls<=0) error stop 'missing analytic evaluations'
   print '(a,2f18.12)', 'Computed minimizer: ',x
   print '(a,f18.12)', 'Independent objective (expected 2): ',independent
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum bound violation: ',feasibility
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Projected gradient residual: ',projected
   print '(a,i0)', 'Objective evaluations: ',objective_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Gradient evaluations: ',gradient_calls
   print '(a,a)', 'Solver termination: ',trim(task)
   print '(a)', 'PASS lbfgsb-box-quadratic'
end program

name: gams-nlopt-box-quadratic
source:
! Original checked bound-constrained quadratic example using the public NLopt API.
module box_model
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: lower(2)=[0._wp,0._wp],upper(2)=[1._wp,2._wp],target(2)=[2._wp,-1._wp]
   integer :: objective_calls=0,gradient_calls=0
contains
   pure function value(x) result(f)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp) :: f
      f=sum((x-target)**2)
   end function
   pure function derivative(x) result(g)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp) :: g(size(x))
      g=2._wp*(x-target)
   end function
   subroutine check_gradient()
      real(wp) :: x(2),plus(2),minus(2),fd(2)
      real(wp), parameter :: h=1.e-6_wp
      integer :: j
      x=[0.25_wp,1._wp]
      do j=1,2
         plus=x; minus=x; plus(j)=plus(j)+h; minus(j)=minus(j)-h
         fd(j)=(value(plus)-value(minus))/(2._wp*h)
      end do
      if (maxval(abs(fd-derivative(x)))>1.e-7_wp) error stop 'analytic objective gradient'
   end subroutine
   function objective(x,gradient,func_data) result(f)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp), optional, intent(inout) :: gradient(:)
      class(*), optional, intent(in) :: func_data
      real(wp) :: f
      objective_calls=objective_calls+1
      f=value(x)
      if (present(gradient)) then
         gradient_calls=gradient_calls+1
         gradient=derivative(x)
      end if
   end function
end module
program checked_box_minimum
   use box_model
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use nlopt_wrap
   use nlopt_enum, only: algorithm_from_string
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(2),reported,independent,feasibility,projected
   type(nlopt_opt) :: opt
   integer :: status
   call check_gradient()
   call create(opt,algorithm_from_string('LD_LBFGS'),2)
   associate(f=>nlopt_func(objective))
      call opt%set_min_objective(f,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'NLopt objective setup'
      call opt%set_lower_bounds(lower,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'NLopt lower bounds'
      call opt%set_upper_bounds(upper,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'NLopt upper bounds'
      call opt%set_xtol_rel(1.e-10_wp,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'NLopt x tolerance'
      call opt%set_ftol_abs(1.e-14_wp,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'NLopt objective tolerance'
      call opt%set_maxeval(1000,status)
      if (status<0) error stop 'NLopt evaluation limit'
      x=[0.25_wp,1._wp]
      call opt%optimize(x,reported,status)
   end associate
   call destroy(opt)
   if (status<1.or.status>4) error stop 'NLopt stopped without convergence'
   if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.ieee_is_finite(reported)) error stop 'nonfinite optimum'
   independent=value(x)
   feasibility=max(0._wp,maxval(lower-x),maxval(x-upper))
   projected=maxval(abs(x-min(upper,max(lower,x-derivative(x)))))
   if (feasibility>1.e-10_wp.or.projected>1.e-8_wp) error stop 'box feasibility/stationarity'
   if (maxval(abs(x-[1._wp,0._wp]))>1.e-8_wp.or.abs(independent-2._wp)>1.e-8_wp) &
      error stop 'known box optimum'
   if (abs(reported-independent)>1.e-10_wp) error stop 'reported objective disagreement'
   if (objective_calls<=0.or.gradient_calls<=0) error stop 'missing analytic evaluations'
   print '(a,2f18.12)', 'Computed minimizer: ',x
   print '(a,f18.12)', 'Independent objective (expected 2): ',independent
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum bound violation: ',feasibility
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Projected gradient residual: ',projected
   print '(a,i0)', 'Objective evaluations: ',objective_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Gradient evaluations: ',gradient_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Solver termination code: ',status
   print '(a)', 'PASS nlopt-box-quadratic'
end program

module constrained_model
   use slsqp_module, only: slsqp_solver
   use slsqp_kinds, only: wp
   implicit none
   integer :: objective_calls=0,gradient_calls=0
contains
   pure subroutine model(x,f,c,g,a)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: f,c(:),g(:),a(:,:)
      f=(x(1)-2._wp)**2+(x(2)+1._wp)**2
      c(1)=sum(x)-1._wp ! Equality c(1)=0 comes first.
      c(2)=1._wp-sum(x*x) ! SLSQP inequalities use c>=0.
      g=2._wp*(x-[2._wp,-1._wp])
      a(1,:)=1._wp; a(2,:)=-2._wp*x
   end subroutine
   subroutine objective(me,x,f,c)
      class(slsqp_solver), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: f,c(:)
      real(wp) :: g(2),a(2,2)
      objective_calls=objective_calls+1
      call model(x,f,c,g,a)
   end subroutine
   subroutine gradient(me,x,g,a)
      class(slsqp_solver), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: g(:),a(:,:)
      real(wp) :: f,c(2)
      gradient_calls=gradient_calls+1
      call model(x,f,c,g,a)
   end subroutine
   subroutine check_derivatives()
      real(wp) :: x(2),plus(2),minus(2),f,c(2),g(2),a(2,2),fp,fm,cp(2),cm(2),unused_g(2),unused_a(2,2)
      real(wp), parameter :: h=1.e-6_wp
      integer :: j
      x=[0.5_wp,0.5_wp]
      call model(x,f,c,g,a)
      do j=1,2
         plus=x; minus=x; plus(j)=plus(j)+h; minus(j)=minus(j)-h
         call model(plus,fp,cp,unused_g,unused_a)
         call model(minus,fm,cm,unused_g,unused_a)
         if (abs((fp-fm)/(2*h)-g(j))>1.e-7_wp) error stop 'objective gradient check'
         if (maxval(abs((cp-cm)/(2*h)-a(:,j)))>1.e-7_wp) error stop 'constraint Jacobian check'
      end do
   end subroutine
end module
program checked_circle_equality
   use constrained_model
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(slsqp_solver) :: solver
   real(wp) :: x(2),f,c(2),g(2),a(2,2),feasibility,stationarity,complementarity
   integer :: status,iterations
   logical :: initialized
   call check_derivatives()
   call solver%initialize(2,2,1,200,1.e-12_wp,objective,gradient, &
      [-2._wp,-2._wp],[2._wp,2._wp],status_ok=initialized,gradient_mode=0)
   if (.not.initialized) error stop 'SLSQP initialization'
   x=[0.5_wp,0.5_wp]
   call solver%optimize(x,status,iterations)
   if (status/=0.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'SLSQP convergence'
   call model(x,f,c,g,a)
   if (.not.ieee_is_finite(f).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(c))) error stop 'nonfinite objective/constraints'
   feasibility=max(abs(c(1)),max(0._wp,-c(2)),maxval(abs(x))-2._wp)
   ! Independent exact KKT multipliers: lambda=2 for the equality, mu=2>=0 for c(2)>=0.
   stationarity=maxval(abs(g-2._wp*a(1,:)-2._wp*a(2,:)))
   complementarity=abs(2._wp*c(2))
   if (max(feasibility,stationarity,complementarity)>1.e-7_wp) error stop 'independent KKT checks'
   if (maxval(abs(x-[1._wp,0._wp]))>1.e-7_wp.or.abs(f-2._wp)>1.e-7_wp) error stop 'known optimum'
   if (objective_calls<=0.or.gradient_calls<=0) error stop 'missing analytic callbacks'
   print '(a,2f18.12)', 'Computed minimizer: ',x
   print '(a,f18.12)', 'Independent objective (expected 2): ',f
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum primal constraint violation: ',feasibility
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Stationarity with known multipliers (2,2): ',stationarity
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Complementarity residual: ',complementarity
   print '(a,i0)', 'Objective/constraint callback calls: ',objective_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Gradient/Jacobian callback calls: ',gradient_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Iterations: ',iterations
   print '(a,i0)', 'Solver termination code: ',status
   print '(a)', 'PASS slsqp-circle-equality'
end program

program checked_special_functions
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use fullerton_gamma, only: fgamma,log_gamma,reciprocal_gamma
   implicit none
   real, parameter :: arguments(7)=[0.5,1.,1.5,2.,2.5,5.,10.]
   real(wp) :: reference(7),pi,values(3),errors(3),maximum_errors(3)
   integer :: j
   pi=acos(-1._wp)
   ! Factorials and half-integer Gamma identities, computed independently in real64.
   reference=[sqrt(pi),1._wp,sqrt(pi)/2._wp,1._wp,3._wp*sqrt(pi)/4._wp,24._wp,362880._wp]
   maximum_errors=0._wp
   print '(a,i0)', 'Default-real precision (decimal digits): ',precision(1.)
   print '(a)', '       x        Gamma(x)           relative Gamma error   scaled log error   relative reciprocal error'
   do j=1,size(arguments)
      values=[real(fgamma(arguments(j)),wp),real(log_gamma(arguments(j)),wp),real(reciprocal_gamma(arguments(j)),wp)]
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(values))) error stop 'nonfinite Gamma-family result'
      errors(1)=abs(values(1)-reference(j))/reference(j)
      errors(2)=abs(values(2)-log(reference(j)))/max(1._wp,abs(log(reference(j))))
      errors(3)=abs(values(3)*reference(j)-1._wp)
      if (maxval(errors)>3.e-6_wp) error stop 'independent Gamma-family values'
      maximum_errors=max(maximum_errors,errors)
      print '(f8.2,es20.10,3es20.6)', arguments(j),values(1),errors
   end do
   print '(a,3es12.4)', 'Maximum Gamma/log/reciprocal errors: ',maximum_errors
   print '(a)', 'PASS fullerton-gamma-values'
end program

program checked_special_functions
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use fullerton_gamma, only: digamma
   implicit none
   real, parameter :: arguments(7)=[0.5,1.,1.5,2.,2.5,5.,10.]
   real, parameter :: recurrence_points(5)=[0.25,0.5,1.5,3.25,10.]
   real, parameter :: reflection_points(3)=[0.125,0.25,0.375]
   real(wp), parameter :: euler=0.577215664901532860606512090082402431_wp
   real(wp) :: reference(7),half_psi,value,pi,error,max_error,recurrence_error,reflection_error,z
   real :: x
   integer :: j
   pi=acos(-1._wp); half_psi=-euler-2._wp*log(2._wp)
   reference=[half_psi,-euler,half_psi+2._wp,1._wp-euler,half_psi+8._wp/3._wp, &
      25._wp/12._wp-euler,-euler]
   do j=1,9
      reference(7)=reference(7)+1._wp/real(j,wp)
   end do
   max_error=0._wp; recurrence_error=0._wp; reflection_error=0._wp
   print '(a,i0)', 'Default-real precision (decimal digits): ',precision(1.)
   print '(a)', '       x           psi(x)              absolute reference error'
   do j=1,size(arguments)
      value=real(digamma(arguments(j)),wp)
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'nonfinite digamma value'
      error=abs(value-reference(j)); max_error=max(max_error,error)
      if (error>5.e-6_wp) error stop 'independent digamma reference'
      print '(f8.2,es24.12,es24.6)',arguments(j),value,error
   end do
   do j=1,size(recurrence_points)
      x=recurrence_points(j)
      value=real(digamma(x+1.),wp)-real(digamma(x),wp)-1._wp/real(x,wp)
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'nonfinite digamma recurrence'
      recurrence_error=max(recurrence_error,abs(value))
   end do
   do j=1,size(reflection_points)
      x=reflection_points(j); z=real(x,wp)
      value=real(digamma(1.-x),wp)-real(digamma(x),wp)-pi/tan(pi*z)
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'nonfinite digamma reflection'
      reflection_error=max(reflection_error,abs(value))
   end do
   if (max(recurrence_error,reflection_error)>5.e-6_wp) error stop 'digamma identities'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum absolute reference error: ',max_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum recurrence residual: ',recurrence_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum reflection residual: ',reflection_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS fullerton-digamma-values'
end program

program checked_special_functions
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use bessels, only: wp=>BK,besseli0,besseli1,besselk0,besselk1
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: arguments(7)=[0.125_wp,0.25_wp,0.5_wp,1._wp,2._wp,4._wp,8._wp]
   ! mpmath 1.3.0, 80 decimal digits; rows are I0,I1,K0,K1 at each argument.
   real(wp), parameter :: references(4,7)=reshape([ &
      1.0039100663533544851278_wp,0.062622149811234825444244_wp,2.2078690867449700600076_wp,7.8311182991157511634643_wp, &
      1.0156861412236079233547_wp,0.12597910894546792590771_wp,1.5415067512483028161695_wp,3.7470259744407116380341_wp, &
      1.0634833707413235192632_wp,0.25789430539089631636248_wp,0.92441907122766586178192_wp,1.6564411200033008936964_wp, &
      1.2660658777520083355982_wp,0.5651591039924850272077_wp,0.42102443824070833333563_wp,0.60190723019723457473754_wp, &
      2.2795853023360672674372_wp,1.5906368546373290633823_wp,0.11389387274953343565272_wp,0.1398658818165224272846_wp, &
      11.301921952136330496356_wp,9.7594651537044499094752_wp,0.011159676085853024269745_wp,0.012483498887268431470384_wp, &
      427.5641157218047851774_wp,399.87313678256009821908_wp,0.00014647070522281538709658_wp,0.00015536921180500113391686_wp],[4,7])
   real(wp) :: x,values(4),series_values(2),relative_error,series_error,identity_error
   real(wp) :: max_reference_error,max_series_error,max_identity_error
   integer :: j
   max_reference_error=0._wp; max_series_error=0._wp; max_identity_error=0._wp
   print '(a,i0)', 'Bessel kind precision (decimal digits): ',precision(1._wp)
   print '(a)', '       x       relative table error     relative I-series error   Wronskian residual'
   do j=1,size(arguments)
      x=arguments(j)
      values=[besseli0(x),besseli1(x),besselk0(x),besselk1(x)]
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(values)).or.any(values<=0._wp)) error stop 'invalid positive-argument Bessel values'
      relative_error=maxval(abs(values-references(:,j))/references(:,j))
      call independent_i_series(x,series_values)
      series_error=maxval(abs(values(1:2)-series_values)/series_values)
      identity_error=abs(x*(values(1)*values(4)+values(2)*values(3))-1._wp)
      if (max(relative_error,series_error)>2.e-12_wp.or.identity_error>1.e-11_wp) &
         error stop 'independent modified Bessel checks'
      max_reference_error=max(max_reference_error,relative_error)
      max_series_error=max(max_series_error,series_error)
      max_identity_error=max(max_identity_error,identity_error)
      print '(f8.3,3es24.8)',x,relative_error,series_error,identity_error
   end do
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum relative table error (all four functions): ',max_reference_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum relative I0/I1 series error: ',max_series_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum Wronskian residual: ',max_identity_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS bessels-modified-values'
contains
   subroutine independent_i_series(x,sums)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp), intent(out) :: sums(2)
      real(wp) :: terms(2),factor
      integer :: k
      factor=x*x/4._wp; terms=[1._wp,x/2._wp]; sums=terms
      do k=1,1000
         terms(1)=terms(1)*factor/real(k*k,wp)
         terms(2)=terms(2)*factor/real(k*(k+1),wp)
         sums=sums+terms
         if (all(terms<=epsilon(1._wp)*sums)) return
      end do
      error stop 'independent I-series did not converge'
   end subroutine
end program

! OF THIS SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
program checked_decomposition
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use la_lapack, only: syev
   implicit none
   integer :: info,lwork
   real(wp) :: query_work(1)
   real(wp), allocatable :: work(:)
   real(wp) :: identity(3,3),scale,reconstruction_error,orthogonality_error
   integer :: problem,j
   real(wp) :: a(3,3),original(3,3),vectors(3,3),eigenvalues(3),expected(3),weighted(3,3),equation_error
   identity=0._wp
   do j=1,3
      identity(j,j)=1._wp
   end do
   do problem=1,2
      ! A 2-by-2 symmetric block has eigenvalues 1 and 3.
      a=reshape([2._wp,1._wp,0._wp,1._wp,2._wp,0._wp,0._wp,0._wp,4._wp],[3,3])
      if (problem==2) a(3,3)=3._wp ! Repeated eigenvalue: its basis is not unique.
      expected=[1._wp,3._wp,a(3,3)]
      original=a
      call syev('V','U',3,a,3,eigenvalues,query_work,-1,info)
      if (info/=0.or..not.ieee_is_finite(query_work(1))) error stop 'SYEV workspace query'
      lwork=max(1,ceiling(query_work(1))); allocate(work(lwork))
      a=original
      call syev('V','U',3,a,3,eigenvalues,work,lwork,info)
      deallocate(work)
      if (info/=0) error stop 'SYEV status'
      vectors=a
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(eigenvalues)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(vectors))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite eigensystem'
      do j=1,3
         weighted(:,j)=vectors(:,j)*eigenvalues(j)
      end do
      scale=max(1._wp,sqrt(sum(original**2)))
      equation_error=sqrt(sum((matmul(original,vectors)-weighted)**2))/scale
      reconstruction_error=sqrt(sum((matmul(weighted,transpose(vectors))-original)**2))/scale
      orthogonality_error=sqrt(sum((matmul(transpose(vectors),vectors)-identity)**2))
      if (maxval(abs(eigenvalues-expected))>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'known eigenvalues'
      if (max(equation_error,reconstruction_error,orthogonality_error)>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'eigen identities'
      print '(a,i0)', 'Symmetric eigenproblem case (2 has a repeated eigenvalue): ',problem
      print '(a,3f18.12)', 'Eigenvalues: ',eigenvalues
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Relative Frobenius eigen-equation residual: ',equation_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Relative Frobenius reconstruction error: ',reconstruction_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Column orthogonality error: ',orthogonality_error
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortran-lapack-symmetric-eigen'
end program

program checked_decomposition
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use linear_algebra, only: qr
   use la_state_type, only: la_state
   implicit none
   type(la_state) :: state
   real(wp) :: identity(3,3),scale,reconstruction_error,orthogonality_error
   integer :: problem,j
   real(wp), parameter :: t(4)=[-1._wp,0._wp,1._wp,2._wp]
   real(wp) :: a(4,3),original(4,3),q(4,3),r(3,3),triangle_error
   real(wp) :: b(4),rhs(3),coefficients(3),expected(3),residual(4),optimality,sse
   integer :: k
   identity=0._wp
   do j=1,3
      identity(j,j)=1._wp
   end do
   do problem=1,2
      a(:,1)=1._wp; a(:,2)=t; a(:,3)=t*t
      if (problem==2) a(:,3)=2._wp*t ! Known dependent column.
      original=a
      call qr(a,q,r,err=state)
      if (state%error()) then
         print *,state%print()
         error stop 'QR factorization status'
      end if
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(q)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(r))) error stop 'nonfinite QR factors'
      scale=max(1._wp,sqrt(sum(original**2)))
      reconstruction_error=sqrt(sum((matmul(q,r)-original)**2))/scale
      orthogonality_error=sqrt(sum((matmul(transpose(q),q)-identity)**2))
      triangle_error=0._wp
      do j=1,3
         do k=1,j-1
            triangle_error=max(triangle_error,abs(r(j,k)))
         end do
      end do
      if (max(reconstruction_error,orthogonality_error,triangle_error)>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'QR identities'
      print '(a,i0)', 'Reduced QR case (2 has dependent columns): ',problem
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum lower-triangular R entry: ',triangle_error
      if (problem==1) then
         ! Noise [-1,3,-3,1]/10 is orthogonal to columns [1,t,t**2].
         expected=[1._wp,-2._wp,0.5_wp]
         b=matmul(original,expected)+[-0.1_wp,0.3_wp,-0.3_wp,0.1_wp]
         rhs=matmul(transpose(q),b)
         coefficients=0._wp
         do j=3,1,-1
            if (abs(r(j,j))<1.e-12_wp) error stop 'unexpected rank loss'
            coefficients(j)=(rhs(j)-dot_product(r(j,j+1:3),coefficients(j+1:3)))/r(j,j)
         end do
         residual=matmul(original,coefficients)-b
         optimality=maxval(abs(matmul(transpose(original),residual)))
         sse=sum(residual**2)
         if (maxval(abs(coefficients-expected))>1.e-12_wp.or.optimality>1.e-12_wp) &
            error stop 'QR least-squares coefficients/optimality'
         if (abs(sse-0.2_wp)>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'QR least-squares residual norm'
         print '(a,3f18.12)', 'Least-squares coefficients: ',coefficients
         print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum absolute A-transpose residual: ',optimality
         print '(a,f18.12)', 'Residual sum of squares (expected 0.2): ',sse
      else
         if (abs(r(3,3))/scale>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'known dependent QR column'
         print '(a)', 'Dependent column detected; triangular solve skipped.'
      end if
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Relative Frobenius reconstruction error: ',reconstruction_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Column orthogonality error: ',orthogonality_error
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortran-lapack-qr-decomposition'
end program

! CAUSED AND ON ANY THEORY OF LIABILITY, WHETHER IN CONTRACT, STRICT LIABILITY,
! OR TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE OR OTHERWISE) ARISING IN ANY WAY OUT OF THE USE
! OF THIS SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
program checked_decomposition
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use la_lapack, only: gesvd
   implicit none
   integer :: info,lwork
   real(wp) :: query_work(1)
   real(wp), allocatable :: work(:)
   real(wp) :: identity(3,3),scale,reconstruction_error,orthogonality_error
   integer :: problem,j
   real(wp) :: a(4,3),original(4,3),u(4,3),vt(3,3),singular(3),expected(3),weighted(4,3)
   real(wp) :: right_orthogonality_error,rank_threshold
   integer :: numerical_rank
   identity=0._wp
   do j=1,3
      identity(j,j)=1._wp
   end do
   do problem=1,2
      ! The first block has singular values 3 and 0; the third column adds 2.
      a=0._wp
      a(1:2,1:2)=1.5_wp; a(3,3)=2._wp
      expected=[3._wp,2._wp,0._wp]
      if (problem==2) then
         a(4,:)=[1._wp,-1._wp,0._wp]
         expected(3)=sqrt(2._wp)
      end if
      original=a
      call gesvd('S','S',4,3,a,4,singular,u,4,vt,3,query_work,-1,info)
      if (info/=0.or..not.ieee_is_finite(query_work(1))) error stop 'GESVD workspace query'
      lwork=max(1,ceiling(query_work(1))); allocate(work(lwork))
      a=original
      call gesvd('S','S',4,3,a,4,singular,u,4,vt,3,work,lwork,info)
      deallocate(work)
      if (info/=0) error stop 'GESVD status'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(singular)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(u)).or. &
          .not.all(ieee_is_finite(vt))) error stop 'nonfinite SVD'
      if (any(singular<0._wp).or.any(singular(1:2)<singular(2:3))) error stop 'singular value ordering'
      do j=1,3
         weighted(:,j)=u(:,j)*singular(j)
      end do
      scale=max(1._wp,sqrt(sum(original**2)))
      reconstruction_error=sqrt(sum((matmul(weighted,vt)-original)**2))/scale
      orthogonality_error=sqrt(sum((matmul(transpose(u),u)-identity)**2))
      right_orthogonality_error=sqrt(sum((matmul(vt,transpose(vt))-identity)**2))
      if (maxval(abs(singular-expected))>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'known singular values'
      if (max(reconstruction_error,orthogonality_error,right_orthogonality_error)>1.e-12_wp) &
         error stop 'SVD identities'
      rank_threshold=4._wp*epsilon(1._wp)*maxval(singular)
      numerical_rank=count(singular>rank_threshold)
      if (numerical_rank/=problem+1) error stop 'known numerical rank'
      print '(a,i0)', 'Reduced SVD case (1 has rank 2; 2 has rank 3): ',problem
      print '(a,3f18.12)', 'Singular values: ',singular
      print '(a,i0)', 'Numerical rank: ',numerical_rank
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Right-factor orthogonality error: ',right_orthogonality_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Relative Frobenius reconstruction error: ',reconstruction_error
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Column orthogonality error: ',orthogonality_error
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortran-lapack-svd-decomposition'
end program

program checked_descriptive_statistics
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_stats, only: mean
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: base(5)=[1._wp,2._wp,3._wp,4._wp,5._wp]
   logical, parameter :: mask(5)=[.true.,.false.,.true.,.false.,.true.]
   real(wp) :: samples(5),answer,expected,error,max_error
   integer :: problem
   real(wp) :: matrix(5,2),columns(2)
   max_error=0._wp
   do problem=1,4
      select case(problem)
      case(1)
         samples=base
      case(2)
         samples=1.e6_wp+2._wp*base
      case(3)
         samples=7.25_wp
      case(4)
         samples=-3._wp*base
      end select
      select case(problem)
      case(1)
         expected=3._wp
      case(2)
         expected=1.e6_wp+6._wp
      case(3)
         expected=7.25_wp
      case(4)
         expected=-9._wp
      end select
      answer=mean(samples)
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(answer)) error stop 'nonfinite mean'
      error=abs(answer-expected)/max(1._wp,abs(expected))
      if (error>64._wp*epsilon(1._wp)) error stop 'independent known mean'
      max_error=max(max_error,error)
      print '(a,i0)', 'Mean case: ',problem
      print '(a,es22.14)', 'Computed mean: ',answer
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Scaled absolute mean error: ',error
   end do
   answer=mean(pack(base,mask))
   if (.not.ieee_is_finite(answer).or.abs(answer-3._wp)>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'packed subset mean'
   print '(a,es22.14)', 'Mean of subset [1,3,5]: ',answer
   answer=mean(base,mask=mask)
   if (.not.ieee_is_finite(answer).or.abs(answer-3._wp)>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'native masked mean'
   matrix(:,1)=base; matrix(:,2)=2._wp*base
   columns=mean(matrix,dim=1)
   if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(columns)).or.maxval(abs(columns-[3._wp,6._wp]))>1.e-12_wp) &
      error stop 'column means'
   print '(a,2f18.12)', 'Column means [base,2*base]: ',columns
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled mean error: ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-mean-checks'
end program

program checked_descriptive_statistics
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_stats, only: var
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: base(5)=[1._wp,2._wp,3._wp,4._wp,5._wp]
   logical, parameter :: mask(5)=[.true.,.false.,.true.,.false.,.true.]
   real(wp) :: samples(5),answer,expected,error,max_error
   integer :: problem
   real(wp) :: matrix(5,2),columns(2)
   real(wp) :: population,expected_population
   max_error=0._wp
   do problem=1,4
      select case(problem)
      case(1)
         samples=base
      case(2)
         samples=1.e6_wp+2._wp*base
      case(3)
         samples=7.25_wp
      case(4)
         samples=-3._wp*base
      end select
      select case(problem)
      case(1)
         expected=2.5_wp
      case(2)
         expected=10._wp
      case(3)
         expected=0._wp
      case(4)
         expected=22.5_wp
      end select
      answer=var(samples,corrected=.true.)
      population=var(samples,corrected=.false.)
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(answer).or..not.ieee_is_finite(population)) error stop 'nonfinite variance'
      if (answer<0._wp.or.population<0._wp) error stop 'negative variance'
      expected_population=expected*4._wp/5._wp
      error=max(abs(answer-expected)/max(1._wp,expected), &
         abs(population-expected_population)/max(1._wp,expected_population))
      if (error>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'independent sample/population variance'
      max_error=max(max_error,error)
      print '(a,i0)', 'Variance case: ',problem
      print '(a,f18.12)', 'Sample variance (N-1 denominator): ',answer
      print '(a,f18.12)', 'Population variance (N denominator): ',population
      print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled variance error: ',error
   end do
   answer=var(pack(base,mask),corrected=.true.)
   if (.not.ieee_is_finite(answer).or.abs(answer-4._wp)>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'packed subset variance'
   print '(a,f18.12)', 'Sample variance of subset [1,3,5]: ',answer
   answer=var(base,mask=mask,corrected=.true.)
   population=var(base,mask=mask,corrected=.false.)
   if (.not.ieee_is_finite(answer).or..not.ieee_is_finite(population)) error stop 'nonfinite masked variance'
   if (abs(answer-4._wp)>1.e-12_wp.or.abs(population-8._wp/3._wp)>1.e-12_wp) &
      error stop 'native masked variance'
   matrix(:,1)=base; matrix(:,2)=2._wp*base
   columns=var(matrix,dim=1,corrected=.true.)
   if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(columns)).or.maxval(abs(columns-[2.5_wp,10._wp]))>1.e-12_wp) &
      error stop 'column variances'
   print '(a,2f18.12)', 'Column sample variances [base,2*base]: ',columns
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled variance error: ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-sample-variance-checks'
end program

program checked_random_sequence
