   use stdlib_sorting, only: sort
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer(int32), parameter :: input(8)=[5,-3,0,-3,2,1,5,-1],expected(8)=[-3,-3,-1,0,1,2,5,5]
   real(wp), parameter :: real_input(7)=[2.5_wp,-1.25_wp,0._wp,0.5_wp,-1.25_wp,2._wp,-3._wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: real_expected(7)=[-3._wp,-1.25_wp,-1.25_wp,0._wp,0.5_wp,2._wp,2.5_wp]
   integer(int32) :: values(8),large(64),large_expected(64),original(64),empty(0),single(1)
   real(wp) :: real_values(7)
   integer :: i,value,position,copies
   values=input
   call sort(values)
   if (any(values/=expected)) error stop 'ascending integer sort mismatch'
   print '(a,8i5)', 'Ascending integers:',values
   call sort(values)
   if (any(values/=expected)) error stop 'sort is not idempotent'
   values=input
   call sort(values,reverse=.true.)
   if (any(values/=expected(8:1:-1))) error stop 'descending integer sort mismatch'
   print '(a,8i5)', 'Descending integers:',values
   real_values=real_input
   call sort(real_values)
   if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real_values))) error stop 'nonfinite sorted values'
   if (any(real_values/=real_expected)) error stop 'ascending real sort mismatch'
   print '(a,7f9.3)', 'Ascending real values:',real_values
   real_values=real_input
   call sort(real_values,reverse=.true.)
   if (any(real_values/=real_expected(7:1:-1))) error stop 'descending real sort mismatch'
   do i=1,size(large)
      original(i)=modulo(37*i,17)-8
   end do
   ! Build an exact sorted reference from counts in the known integer range, not another sort.
   position=0
   do value=-8,8
      copies=count(original==value)
      large_expected(position+1:position+copies)=value
      position=position+copies
   end do
   if (position/=size(large)) error stop 'histogram reference size'
   large=original
   call sort(large)
   if (any(large/=large_expected)) error stop 'histogram-reference sort mismatch'
   print '(a,i0,a)', 'Sorted ',size(large),' repeated integers against a histogram reference.'
   call sort(empty)
   single=[42]
   call sort(single)
   if (single(1)/=42) error stop 'singleton sort mismatch'
   print '(a)', 'Empty and singleton arrays checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-sorting-reference'
end program

name: gams-primes-trial-division
source:
! GAMS B: prime enumeration and primality, checked against independent trial division.
! Author API patterns: perazz/fortran-primes test/test_primes.f90 at the catalog pin.
! See licenses/fortran-primes-MIT.txt and the upstream source's additional notices.
! Known pinned limitation: is_prime(3215031751_int64) times out; retained under docs/gams-candidates.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int32, int64
   use prime_numbers, only: primes, is_prime
   implicit none
   integer(int32), allocatable :: actual(:), expected(:)
   integer(int32) :: n, k, reference(1000)
   integer(int64), parameter :: large_cases(*) = [ &
      -2_int64, 0_int64, 1_int64, 2_int64, 2147483647_int64, &
      10000000019_int64, 10000000020_int64, 10000000021_int64]

   k = 0
   do n = -20, 1000
      if (is_prime(n) .neqv. trial_prime(int(n, int64))) then
         print '(a,i0)', 'Primality mismatch for ', n
         error stop 'int32 primality check'
      end if
      if (trial_prime(int(n, int64))) then
         k = k + 1
         reference(k) = n
      end if
   end do
   expected = reference(:k)
   actual = primes(1000_int32)
   if (size(actual) /= size(expected)) error stop 'prime list size'
   if (any(actual /= expected)) error stop 'prime list values'
   if (size(actual) /= 168 .or. sum(actual) /= 76127) error stop 'known count and sum'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Primes through 1000: count = ', size(actual), '; sum = ', sum(actual)

   expected = pack(reference(:k), reference(:k) >= 100 .and. reference(:k) <= 200)
   actual = primes(100_int32, 200_int32)
   if (size(actual) /= size(expected)) error stop 'bounded list size'
   if (any(actual /= expected)) error stop 'bounded list values'
   print '(a,*(1x,i0))', 'Primes in [100,200]:', actual
   actual = primes(1_int32)
   if (size(actual) /= 0) error stop 'no primes below two'
   actual = primes(10_int32, 2_int32)
   if (size(actual) /= 0) error stop 'reversed range'

   do k = 1, size(large_cases)
      if (is_prime(large_cases(k)) .neqv. trial_prime(large_cases(k))) then
         print '(a,i0)', 'Primality mismatch for ', large_cases(k)
         error stop 'int64 primality check'
      end if
      print '(a,i0,a,l1)', 'is_prime(', large_cases(k), ') = ', is_prime(large_cases(k))
   end do
   print '(a)', 'Checked 1021 int32 cases, 8 int64 cases, and enumerated prime lists.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS primes-trial-division'
contains
   logical function trial_prime(value) result(prime)
      integer(int64), intent(in) :: value
      integer(int64) :: divisor
      prime = .false.
      if (value < 2) return
      divisor = 2
      ! Division in the bound avoids squaring a potentially large divisor.
      do while (divisor <= value / divisor)
         if (modulo(value, divisor) == 0) return
         divisor = divisor + 1
      end do
      prime = .true.
   end function
end program

name: gams-rpn-gcd-lcm-reference
source:
! GAMS B: direct use of the calculator's number-theory routines, without its UI.
! Original API driver; upstream MIT notice retained in licenses/rpn-calculator-MIT.txt.
program main
   use rat, only: gcd, lcm
   implicit none
   integer :: a, b, divisor, multiple, expected_gcd, expected_lcm, checked_lcm
   checked_lcm = 0
   do a = 0, 64
      do b = 0, 64
         ! Independent reference: enumerate every possible common divisor.
         expected_gcd = 0
         do divisor = 1, max(a, b)
            if (modulo(a, divisor) == 0 .and. modulo(b, divisor) == 0) expected_gcd = divisor
         end do
         if (gcd(a, b) /= expected_gcd) then
            print '(a,2(1x,i0))', 'GCD mismatch:', a, b
            error stop 'greatest common divisor'
         end if
         ! The pinned LCM implementation divides by gcd(a,b): (0,0) is outside its domain.
         if (a == 0 .and. b == 0) cycle
         expected_lcm = 0
         if (a > 0 .and. b > 0) then
            ! Search positive multiples; do not use gcd or the package LCM formula.
            do multiple = max(a, b), a*b, max(a, b)
               if (modulo(multiple, a) == 0 .and. modulo(multiple, b) == 0) then
                  expected_lcm = multiple
                  exit
               end if
            end do
         end if
         if (lcm(a, b) /= expected_lcm) then
            print '(a,2(1x,i0))', 'LCM mismatch:', a, b
            error stop 'least common multiple'
         end if
         checked_lcm = checked_lcm + 1
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'gcd(48,18) = ', gcd(48,18)
   print '(a,i0)', 'lcm(48,18) = ', lcm(48,18)
   print '(a)', 'Checked 4225 GCD and 4224 LCM cases for operands 0 through 64.'
   if (checked_lcm /= 4224) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a)', 'Zero operands checked; lcm(0,0), negative signs and overflow are outside this example.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS rpn-gcd-lcm-reference'
end program

name: gams-rational-addition-reference
source:
! Original GAMS A2 API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int64
   use rational_number, only: rationalnumber_t, ratNumInit, ratNumAdd, ratNumToStr, &
      ratNumGetNumerator, ratNumGetDenominator
   implicit none
   type(rationalnumber_t) :: left, right, answer
   integer :: p, q, r, s, mode, calls, num, den, divisor, common
   integer(int64) :: expected_num, expected_den
   calls = 0
   do p = -4, 4
      do q = 1, 6
         do r = -4, 4
            do s = 1, 6
               left = ratNumInit(p, q)
               right = ratNumInit(r, s)
               expected_num = int(p,int64)*s + int(r,int64)*q
               expected_den = int(q,int64)*s
               do mode = 0, 1
                  answer = ratNumAdd(left, right, simplify=(mode == 1))
                  num = ratNumGetNumerator(answer)
                  den = ratNumGetDenominator(answer)
                  if (den <= 0) error stop 'denominator sign'
                  if (int(num,int64)*expected_den /= expected_num*den) error stop 'exact rational sum'
                  if (mode == 1 .and. expected_num > 0) then
                     common = 1
                     do divisor = 1, int(min(expected_num,expected_den))
                        if (modulo(expected_num,int(divisor,int64)) == 0 .and. &
                            modulo(expected_den,int(divisor,int64)) == 0) common = divisor
                     end do
                     if (num /= expected_num/common .or. den /= expected_den/common) &
                        error stop 'positive sum reduction'
                  end if
                  calls = calls + 1
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   answer = ratNumAdd(ratNumInit(1,3), ratNumInit(1,6), simplify=.true.)
   print '(a)', '1/3 + 1/6 = '//ratNumToStr(answer)
   answer = ratNumAdd(ratNumInit(-1,3), ratNumInit(-1,6), simplify=.true.)
   print '(a)', '-1/3 - 1/6 = '//ratNumToStr(answer)//' (same value as -1/2)'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exact additions checked with simplify off/on: ', calls
   if (calls /= 5832) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a)', 'Pinned simplifier does not reduce negative/zero numerators; value checks allow this.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS rational-addition-reference'
end program

name: gams-strith-integer-reference
source:
! Original GAMS A1 API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int64
   use strith, only: strint_type, new_strint, digits
   implicit none
   type(strint_type) :: a, b, result
   integer :: i, j, cases
   character(32) :: expected
   cases = 0
   do i = -20, 20
      do j = -20, 20
         a = new_strint(int(i,int64))
         b = new_strint(int(j,int64))
         result = a + b
         write(expected,'(i0)') i + j
         call check(result, trim(expected))
         result = a - b
         write(expected,'(i0)') i - j
         call check(result, trim(expected))
         cases = cases + 2
      end do
   end do
   ! Exact decimal identities outside int64, without overflowing native integers.
   a = decimal('999999999999999999999999999999')
   b = new_strint(1_int64)
   result = a + b
   call check(result, '1000000000000000000000000000000')
   print '(a)', 'Thirty nines plus one: '//result%to_string(remove_0_padding=.true.)
   a = decimal('1000000000000000000000000000000')
   result = a - b
   call check(result, '999999999999999999999999999999')
   a = decimal('18446744073709551616')
   b = decimal('18446744073709551615')
   result = a - b
   call check(result, '1')
   result = b - a
   call check(result, '-1')
   a = new_strint('-'//repeat('0',digits-31)//'999999999999999999999999999999')
   b = decimal('999999999999999999999999999999')
   result = a + b
   call check(result, '0')
   print '(a,i0,a)', 'Checked ', cases, ' small signed additions/subtractions and 5 large decimal identities.'
   print '(a)', 'Fixed-capacity decimal integers; capacity overflow is outside this example.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS strith-integer-reference'
contains
   function decimal(text) result(value)
      character(*), intent(in) :: text
      type(strint_type) :: value
      if (len(text) >= digits) error stop 'decimal capacity'
      value = new_strint('+'//repeat('0',digits-1-len(text))//text)
   end function
   subroutine check(value, text)
      type(strint_type), intent(in) :: value
      character(*), intent(in) :: text
      character(:), allocatable :: actual
      actual = value%to_string(remove_0_padding=.true.)
      if (actual /= text) then
         print '(a)', 'Expected '//text//'; got '//actual
         error stop 'decimal integer check'
      end if
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-ryu-binary64-roundtrip
source:
! Original GAMS A6 API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
! This tests finite round trips, not a proof of globally shortest decimal strings.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int64, real64
   use ryu, only: d2shortest
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: exponents(*) = [0,1,2,10,511,1022,1023,1024,1535,2045,2046]
   integer(int64), parameter :: mantissas(*) = [0_int64,1_int64,2_int64, &
      2_int64**51-1,2_int64**51,2_int64**52-1]
   integer :: i, j, sign, count, ios
   integer(int64) :: bits
   real(real64) :: value, restored
   character(:), allocatable :: text
   count = 0
   if (storage_size(value) /= 64 .or. radix(value) /= 2 .or. digits(value) /= 53) &
      error stop 'requires IEEE binary64 layout'
   do i = 1, size(exponents)
      do j = 1, size(mantissas)
         do sign = 0, 1
            bits = ior(shiftl(int(exponents(i),int64),52), mantissas(j))
            if (sign == 1) bits = ibset(bits,63)
            value = transfer(bits, value)
            text = d2shortest(value)
            read(text,*,iostat=ios) restored
            if (ios /= 0) then
               print '(a)', 'Unreadable decimal: '//text
               error stop 'decimal parse'
            end if
            if (transfer(restored,0_int64) /= bits) then
               print '(a,z16.16,a,a)', 'Round-trip mismatch for bits ', bits, ': ', text
               error stop 'binary64 round trip'
            end if
            count = count + 1
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (count /= 132) error stop 'case count'
   if (d2shortest(0.0_real64) /= '0.0') error stop 'positive zero spelling'
   if (d2shortest(-0.0_real64) /= '-0.0') error stop 'negative zero spelling'
   print '(a)', 'Smallest subnormal: '//d2shortest(transfer(1_int64,value))
   print '(a)', 'Smallest normal: '//d2shortest(tiny(value))
   print '(a)', 'Largest finite: '//d2shortest(huge(value))
   print '(a)', 'Negative zero: '//d2shortest(-0.0_real64)
   print '(a,i0)', 'Finite binary64 values recovered with identical bits: ', count
   print '(a)', 'NaN/infinity spelling, all bit patterns and shortest-length optimality are outside this example.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS ryu-binary64-roundtrip'
end program

name: gams-mpfun-real-addition
source:
! Original GAMS A3c API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use mpmodule
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: decimal_digits = 120, words = decimal_digits/mpdpw + 2
   integer :: cases
   type(mp_real) :: result
   character(*), parameter :: huge_integer = '1'//repeat('0',80)
   character(*), parameter :: huge_plus_one = '1'//repeat('0',79)//'1'
   cases = 0
   call check(huge_integer, '1', huge_plus_one)
   call check('1', huge_integer, huge_plus_one)
   call check('-'//huge_integer, '-1', '-'//huge_plus_one)
   call check(huge_integer, '-'//huge_integer, '0')
   call check('123456789012345678901234567890', '987654321098765432109876543210', &
      '1111111110111111111011111111100')
   call check('0.125', '0.375', '0.5')
   if (cases /= 6) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a)', 'Exact decimal identity: 10^80 + 1 = 1 followed by 79 zeroes and 1.'
   print '(a)', 'Also checked operand order, negative addition, cancellation and an explicit 31-digit sum.'
   print '(a)', 'Computed dyadic sum 0.125 + 0.375:'
   call mpwrite(6,30,8,result)
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Checked additions: ', cases, '; requested decimal precision: ', decimal_digits
   print '(a)', 'PASS mpfun-real-addition'
contains
   subroutine check(left_text, right_text, expected_text)
      character(*), intent(in) :: left_text, right_text, expected_text
      type(mp_real) :: left, right, expected
      left = number(left_text)
      right = number(right_text)
      expected = number(expected_text)
      result = left + right
      if (result /= expected) then
         print '(a)', left_text//' + '//right_text//' /= '//expected_text
         error stop 'multiprecision real addition'
      end if
      cases = cases + 1
   end subroutine
   function number(text) result(value)
      character(*), intent(in) :: text
      type(mp_real) :: value
      ! The author's decimal-string constructor requires a decimal point.
      if (index(text,'.') == 0) then
         value = mpreal(text//'.0',words)
      else
         value = mpreal(text,words)
      end if
   end function
end program

name: gams-mpfun-complex-addition
source:
! Original GAMS A4c API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use mpmodule

   integer :: cases
   type(mp_complex) :: result
   character(*), parameter :: big = '1'//repeat('0',80)

   cases = 0
   ! Component-wise exact decimal references, independent of another complex solver.
   call check(big, '-'//big, '-'//less_one, plus_two, '1', '2')
   print '(a)', '(10^80,-10^80) + (-(10^80-1),10^80+2), recovered components:'
   call mpwrite(6,30,8,mpreal(result,words),aimag(result))
   call check('-'//big, big, less_one, '-'//plus_two, '-1', '-2')
   call check(big, '1', '1', big, plus_one, plus_one)
   call check('0.125', '-0.25', '0.375', '0.75', '0.5', '0.5')
   call check(big, plus_one, '-'//big, '-'//plus_one, '0', '0')
   if (cases /= 5) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Exact complex sums checked: ', cases, '; requested decimal precision: ', decimal_digits
   print '(a)', 'Checked both components; multiplication and transcendental functions are outside this driver.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS mpfun-complex-addition'

         error stop 'multiprecision complex components'

   function number(text) result(value)
      character(*), intent(in) :: text
      type(mp_real) :: value
      ! The author's decimal-string constructor requires a decimal point.
      if (index(text,'.') == 0) then
         value = mpreal(text//'.0',words)
      else
         value = mpreal(text,words)
      end if
   end function
end program

name: gams-bstrith-bit-reference
source:
! Original GAMS N2 API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use bstrith, only: shift_l, shift_r, xor, not, add, sub
   implicit none
   integer :: value, amount, left, right, checks
   character(8) :: bits, mask, expected
   character(4) :: a, b, reference
   checks = 0
   do value = 0, 255
      write(bits,'(b8.8)') value
      do amount = 1, 7
         write(expected,'(b8.8)') iand(ishft(value,amount),255)
         if (shift_l(bits,amount) /= expected) error stop 'left shift'
         write(expected,'(b8.8)') ishft(value,-amount)
         if (shift_r(bits,amount) /= expected) error stop 'right shift'
         checks = checks + 2
      end do
      write(expected,'(b8.8)') ieor(value,255)
      if (not(bits) /= expected) error stop 'bit complement'
      mask = '10100101'
      write(expected,'(b8.8)') ieor(value,165)
      if (xor(bits,mask) /= expected) error stop 'bit xor'
      write(expected,'(b8.8)') modulo(value+1,256)
      if (add(bits,'00000001') /= expected) error stop '8-bit modular addition'
      write(expected,'(b8.8)') modulo(value-1,256)
      if (sub(bits,'00000001') /= expected) error stop '8-bit modular subtraction'
      checks = checks + 4
   end do
   do left = 0, 15
      do right = 0, 15
         write(a,'(b4.4)') left
         write(b,'(b4.4)') right
         write(reference,'(b4.4)') modulo(left+right,16)
         if (add(a,b) /= reference) error stop '4-bit modular addition'
         write(reference,'(b4.4)') modulo(left-right,16)
         if (sub(a,b) /= reference) error stop '4-bit modular subtraction'
         checks = checks + 2
      end do
   end do
   if (checks /= 5120) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a)', '10100101 shifted left by 2: '//shift_l('10100101',2)
   print '(a)', '10100101 XOR 11110000: '//xor('10100101','11110000')
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent bit/arithmetic checks passed: ', checks
   print '(a)', 'Shift distances 1..7 for every 8-bit value; all pairs of 4-bit arithmetic operands.'
   print '(a)', 'Out-of-range shifts, malformed strings and wider strings are outside this example.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS bstrith-bit-reference'
end program

name: gams-carlson-rf-reference
source:
! Original C14 API driver. MIT: licenses/special-function-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use carlson_elliptic_module, only: wp=>carlson_elliptic_module_wp, drf
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: triples(3,3)=reshape([0.25_wp,1._wp,4._wp, &
      1._wp,2._wp,4._wp, 2._wp,3._wp,5._wp],[3,3])
   real(wp), parameter :: moduli(*)=[0._wp,0.25_wp,0.75_wp,0.95_wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: diagonal(*)=[0.25_wp,1._wp,4._wp]
   real(wp) :: x,y,z,k,actual,reference,coarse,fine,max_error,pi,u,h,total
   integer :: i,j,status
   pi=acos(-1._wp)
   max_error=0
   do i=1,size(diagonal)
      x=diagonal(i)
      actual=drf(x,x,x,status)
      call check(actual,1/sqrt(x),status)
   end do
   do i=1,3
      x=triples(1,i); y=triples(2,i); z=triples(3,i)
      actual=drf(x,y,z,status)
      if(status/=0) error stop 'RF status'
      coarse=rf_integral(x,y,z,2048)
      fine=rf_integral(x,y,z,4096)
      call check(coarse,fine,0)
      call check(actual,fine,0)
      reference=drf(y,z,x,status)
      call check(reference,actual,status)
      reference=drf(4*x,4*y,4*z,status)
      call check(reference,actual/2,status)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'k             Complete elliptic K(k)'
   do i=1,size(moduli)
      k=moduli(i)
      actual=drf(0._wp,1-k*k,1._wp,status)
      if(status/=0) error stop 'elliptic K status'
      h=pi/(2*4096)
      total=1+1/sqrt(1-k*k)
      do j=1,4095
         u=j*h
         total=total+merge(4._wp,2._wp,mod(j,2)==1)/sqrt(1-k*k*sin(u)**2)
      end do
      reference=total*h/3
      call check(actual,reference,0)
      print '(f6.2,f26.16)',k,actual
   end do
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled reference/identity error: ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS carlson-rf-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(value,expected,code)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: value,expected
      integer,intent(in) :: code
      real(wp) :: error
      if(code/=0) error stop 'RF status'
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(value) .or. .not.ieee_is_finite(expected)) error stop 'nonfinite RF'
      error=abs(value-expected)/max(1._wp,abs(expected))
      max_error=max(max_error,error)
      if(error>2.e-11_wp) error stop 'RF reference check'
   end subroutine
   function rf_integral(a,b,c,n) result(value)
      real(wp),intent(in) :: a,b,c
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      real(wp) :: value,t,term,step
      integer :: j
      ! t=1/sqrt(1+u) transforms the defining RF integral to a smooth finite interval.
      step=1._wp/n
      value=1+1/sqrt(a*b*c)
      do j=1,n-1
         t=j*step
         term=1/sqrt((1+(a-1)*t*t)*(1+(b-1)*t*t)*(1+(c-1)*t*t))
         value=value+merge(4._wp,2._wp,mod(j,2)==1)*term
      end do
      value=value*step/3
   end function
end program

name: gams-bernoulli-power-sums
source:
! Original C19 API driver. MIT: licenses/special-function-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int64
   use specfun_module, only: bernob, wp=>specfun_wp
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter :: indices(*)=[0,1,2,4,6,8,10,12], sizes(*)=[3,10,20]
   integer,parameter :: numerators(*)=[1,-1,1,-1,1,-1,5,-691]
   integer,parameter :: denominators(*)=[1,2,6,30,42,30,66,2730]
   real(wp) :: values(0:12),coefficients(0:12),expected,actual,maximum_error,error
   integer(int64) :: direct,choose
   integer :: i,j,p,n,m,checks
   call bernob(12,values)
   maximum_error=0
   coefficients=0
   do i=1,size(indices)
      j=indices(i)
      expected=real(numerators(i),wp)/denominators(i)
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(values(j))) error stop 'nonfinite Bernoulli number'
      error=abs(values(j)-expected)/max(1._wp,abs(expected))
      maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
      if(error>3.e-12_wp) error stop 'Bernoulli rational reference'
      coefficients(j)=values(j)
      print '(a,i0,a,f23.15)', 'B(',j,') = ',values(j)
   end do
   ! bernob does not assign odd output positions >1 at this pin. Do not read them.
   ! Their mathematical zeros are supplied locally for the independent power-sum application.
   checks=0
   do i=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(i)
      do p=1,8
         direct=0
         do m=0,n-1
            direct=direct+int(m,int64)**p
         end do
         actual=0
         choose=1
         do j=0,p
            actual=actual+real(choose,wp)*coefficients(j)*real(n,wp)**(p+1-j)
            choose=choose*(p+1-j)/(j+1)
         end do
         actual=actual/(p+1)
         expected=real(direct,wp)
         error=abs(actual-expected)/max(1._wp,abs(expected))
         maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
         if(.not.ieee_is_finite(actual) .or. error>3.e-12_wp) error stop 'integer power sum'
         checks=checks+1
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent integer power sums checked: ',checks
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled error: ',maximum_error
   print '(a)', 'Odd outputs above B1 are unassigned at this pin and are not read.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS bernoulli-power-sums'
end program

name: gams-amos-complex-series
source:
! Original C10 API driver. MIT: licenses/special-function-drivers-MIT.txt.
! Known pinned failure at z=2-0.75i retained under docs/gams-candidates/amosf90.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use amos, only: f90_zbesj,f90_zbesi,f90_zbesk
   implicit none
   complex(dp),parameter :: arguments(*)=[cmplx(.5_dp,.25_dp,dp),cmplx(1._dp,.5_dp,dp),cmplx(2._dp,.75_dp,dp)]
   real(dp),parameter :: orders(*)=[.3_dp,.5_dp,1.25_dp],pi=acos(-1._dp)
   complex(dp) :: jvalues(2),ivalues(2),kvalue(1),z,reference
   real(dp) :: nu,maximum_error
   integer :: i,j,m,nz,status,checks
   maximum_error=0
   checks=0
   do i=1,size(arguments)
      z=arguments(i)
      do j=1,size(orders)
         nu=orders(j)
         call f90_zbesj(z,nu,1,2,jvalues,nz,status)
         if(status/=0 .or. nz/=0) error stop 'AMOS J status/underflow'
         call f90_zbesi(z,nu,1,2,ivalues,nz,status)
         if(status/=0 .or. nz/=0) error stop 'AMOS I status/underflow'
         do m=1,2
            call check(jvalues(m),series(z,nu+m-1,-1))
            call check(ivalues(m),series(z,nu+m-1,1))
         end do
      end do
      call f90_zbesk(z,.5_dp,1,1,kvalue,nz,status)
      if(status/=0 .or. nz/=0) error stop 'AMOS K status/underflow'
      reference=sqrt(pi/(2*z))*exp(-z)
      call check(kvalue(1),reference)
      print '(a,2f10.4,a,2f20.12)', 'z = ',real(z),aimag(z), '; K_0.5(z) = ',real(kvalue(1)),aimag(kvalue(1))
   end do
   if(checks/=39) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent complex Bessel values checked: ',checks
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled error: ',maximum_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS amos-complex-series'
contains
   subroutine check(value,expected)
      complex(dp),intent(in) :: value,expected
      real(dp) :: error
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite([real(value),aimag(value),real(expected),aimag(expected)]))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite complex reference'
      error=abs(value-expected)/max(1._dp,abs(expected))
      maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
      if(error>2.e-12_dp) then
         print '(a,2f16.8,a,f12.6,a,i0)', 'At z=',real(z),aimag(z),'; starting order=',nu,'; sequence index=',m
         print '(a,2es24.16)', 'Actual:   ',real(value),aimag(value)
         print '(a,2es24.16)', 'Reference:',real(expected),aimag(expected)
         print '(a,es24.16)', 'Scaled error:',error
         error stop 'complex Bessel reference'
      end if
      checks=checks+1
   end subroutine
   function series(x,order,sign_factor) result(value)
      complex(dp),intent(in) :: x
      real(dp),intent(in) :: order
      integer,intent(in) :: sign_factor
      complex(dp) :: value,term,total
      integer :: k
      logical :: converged
      term=cmplx(1._dp,0._dp,dp)
      total=term
      converged=.false.
      do k=1,100
         term=term*(sign_factor*x*x/4)/(k*(order+k))
         total=total+term
         if(abs(term)<=epsilon(1._dp)*max(1._dp,abs(total))) then
            converged=.true.
            exit
         end if
      end do
      if(.not.converged) error stop 'reference series did not converge'
      value=(x/2)**order*total/gamma(order+1)
   end function
end program

name: gams-blas-gemm-reference
source:
! Original D1b6 API driver. MIT: licenses/linear-algebra-api-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use blas, only: blas_gemm
   implicit none
   real(dp) :: base_a(3,2),base_b(2,4),initial(3,4),actual(3,4),expected(3,4)
   real(dp),allocatable :: a(:,:),b(:,:)
   real(dp),parameter :: alphas(*)=[1._dp,-2._dp,0._dp],betas(*)=[0._dp,.5_dp,-1._dp]
   real(dp) :: alpha,beta,error,maximum_error
   character,parameter :: options(*)=['N','T']
   integer :: i,j,k,ta,tb,mode,cases
   do i=1,3
      do k=1,2
         base_a(i,k)=real(2*i-3*k,dp)
      end do
      do j=1,4
         initial(i,j)=real(i-j,dp)/2
      end do
   end do
   do k=1,2
      do j=1,4
         base_b(k,j)=real(3*k-j,dp)
      end do
   end do
   maximum_error=0
   cases=0
   do ta=1,2
      do tb=1,2
         if(ta==1) then
            a=base_a
         else
            a=transpose(base_a)
         end if
         if(tb==1) then
            b=base_b
         else
            b=transpose(base_b)
         end if
         do mode=1,3
            alpha=alphas(mode); beta=betas(mode)
            expected=beta*initial
            ! Independent scalar loops; no MATMUL or another BLAS call supplies the reference.
            do i=1,3
               do j=1,4
                  do k=1,2
                     expected(i,j)=expected(i,j)+alpha*base_a(i,k)*base_b(k,j)
                  end do
               end do
            end do
            actual=initial
            call blas_gemm(options(ta),options(tb),3,4,2,alpha,a,size(a,1),b,size(b,1),beta,actual,3)
            if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'nonfinite GEMM result'
            error=maxval(abs(actual-expected))/max(1._dp,maxval(abs(expected)))
            maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
            if(error>1.e-12_dp) error stop 'GEMM scalar-loop reference'
            cases=cases+1
            if(ta==1 .and. tb==1 .and. mode==1) then
               print '(a)', '3-by-2 times 2-by-4 matrix product:'
               do i=1,3
                  print '(4f12.4)',actual(i,:)
               end do
            end if
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if(cases/=12) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Transpose/scaling combinations checked: ',cases
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled error: ',maximum_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS blas-gemm-reference'
end program

name: gams-fsparse-matvec-reference
source:
! Original D1b4 API driver. MIT: licenses/linear-algebra-api-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use fsparse, only: COO_dp,CSR_dp,dense2coo,coo2csr,matvec
   use fsparse_constants, only: dp
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(COO_dp) :: coo
   type(CSR_dp) :: csr
   real(dp) :: a(4,3),vectors(3,3),x(3),initial(4),product(4),expected(4),ycoo(4),ycsr(4)
   integer :: i,j,v,mode,repetition,calls
   a=reshape([2._dp,0._dp,0._dp,-1._dp, 0._dp,3._dp,0._dp,0._dp, &
      4._dp,0._dp,0._dp,5._dp],[4,3])
   vectors(:,1)=[1._dp,-2._dp,3._dp]
   vectors(:,2)=[0._dp,1._dp,-1._dp]
   vectors(:,3)=0
   call dense2coo(a,coo)
   call coo2csr(coo,csr)
   calls=0
   do v=1,3
      x=vectors(:,v)
      product=0
      do i=1,4
         do j=1,3
            product(i)=product(i)+a(i,j)*x(j)
         end do
      end do
      do mode=0,1
         initial=real(mode,dp)*[.5_dp,-1._dp,7._dp,2._dp]
         ycoo=initial
         ycsr=initial
         do repetition=1,2
            ! This API accumulates y := y+A*x. Repeating the call must add again.
            call matvec(coo,x,ycoo)
            call matvec(csr,x,ycsr)
            expected=initial+repetition*product
            call check(ycoo,expected)
            call check(ycsr,expected)
            calls=calls+2
         end do
      end do
      print '(a,i0,a,4f10.3)', 'A*x for vector ',v,': ',product
   end do
   if(calls/=24) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0)', 'COO/CSR accumulated products checked: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Rectangular 4-by-3 matrix includes an empty row; zero/nonzero output and zero input checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fsparse-matvec-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,reference)
      real(dp),intent(in) :: actual(:),reference(:)
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'nonfinite sparse result'
      if(maxval(abs(actual-reference))>1.e-12_dp) error stop 'sparse scalar-loop reference'
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-forinv-pseudoinverse-reference
source:
! Original D9c API driver. MIT: licenses/linear-algebra-api-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use kinds, only: rk
   use forinv, only: inv
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(rk) :: a(3,2),reference(2,3),square(3,3),square_reference(3,3),u(3),v(2),x(2)
   real(rk),allocatable :: result(:,:)
   integer :: i,j,cases
   cases=0
   u=[1._rk,2._rk,3._rk]
   v=[1._rk,2._rk]
   do i=1,3
      do j=1,2
         a(i,j)=u(i)*v(j)
         ! (u*v^T)^+ = v*u^T / ((u^T*u)*(v^T*v)) = v*u^T/70.
         reference(j,i)=v(j)*u(i)/70
      end do
   end do
   call check(a,reference,result)
   x=matmul(result,u)
   if(maxval(abs(x-[.2_rk,.4_rk]))>1.e-11_rk) error stop 'minimum-norm solution'
   print '(a,2f16.10)', 'Rank-one minimum-norm solution: ',x
   ! Two orthogonal columns, squared norms 9 and 5, give an explicit full-rank inverse.
   a(:,1)=[1._rk,2._rk,2._rk]
   a(:,2)=[2._rk,-1._rk,0._rk]
   reference(1,:)=a(:,1)/9
   reference(2,:)=a(:,2)/5
   call check(a,reference,result)
   call check(transpose(a),transpose(reference),result)
   square=0
   square_reference=0
   square(1,1)=2; square(3,3)=4
   square_reference(1,1)=.5_rk; square_reference(3,3)=.25_rk
   call check(square,square_reference,result)
   a=0; reference=0
   call check(a,reference,result)
   if(cases/=5) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known pseudoinverses and all four Moore-Penrose identities checked: ',cases
   print '(a)', 'Tall, wide, rank-one, singular diagonal and zero matrices; explicit cutoff 1e-10.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS forinv-pseudoinverse-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(original,expected,pseudoinverse)
      real(rk),intent(in) :: original(:,:),expected(:,:)
      real(rk),allocatable,intent(out) :: pseudoinverse(:,:)
      real(rk),allocatable :: workspace(:,:),left(:,:),right(:,:)
      real(rk) :: errors(5)
      ! The pinned ForSVD dependency may overwrite its input; preserve the reference matrix.
      workspace=original
      pseudoinverse=inv(workspace,method='gesvd',tol=1.e-10_rk)
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(pseudoinverse))) error stop 'nonfinite pseudoinverse'
      left=matmul(original,pseudoinverse)
      right=matmul(pseudoinverse,original)
      errors(1)=maxval(abs(pseudoinverse-expected))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(expected)))
      errors(2)=maxval(abs(matmul(left,original)-original))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(original)))
      errors(3)=maxval(abs(matmul(right,pseudoinverse)-pseudoinverse))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(pseudoinverse)))
      errors(4)=maxval(abs(left-transpose(left)))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(left)))
      errors(5)=maxval(abs(right-transpose(right)))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(right)))
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(errors)) .or. any(errors>1.e-11_rk)) error stop 'pseudoinverse references'
      cases=cases+1
      print '(a,i0,a,5es12.3)', 'Case ',cases,' reference and identity errors: ',errors
   end subroutine
end program
